articles.title: 【馮睎乾十三維度】看《牛來》，遇上雪萊
articles.summary: 中國有部好平嘅動畫戲《牛來》，本來畫工麻麻，但故事同對白都幾好，唔算好爛。

levels.text: 中國有套好平嘅動畫戲叫《牛來》，好多人話佢好爛，反而吸引好多人去戲院笑佢，票房升到好高。呢套戲係一對母子做嘅，用咗五年先做完。畫工麻麻，但故事同對白都幾好睇，唔算好爛，只不過係普通啫。
levels.text_en: There's a very cheaply made Chinese animated film called 'Niu Lai' (Calf Comes). Many people say it's terrible, and this actually attracted lots of people to go to the cinema to laugh at it, so the box office rose very high. The film was made by a mother and son, and it took them five years to finish it. The drawing is mediocre, but the story and dialogue are quite good—it's not really terrible, just average.

levels.text: 中國有套好平嘅動畫戲叫《牛來》，好多人話佢「全方位咁爛」，仲有人專程去戲院笑佢，當係搞行為藝術，結果短短半個月，票房升到一千六百幾萬人民幣。呢套戲係一對母子做嘅：兒子本身做裝修，2021年先開始拍戲；媽媽孫麗芳身兼編劇同配樂，仲親自唱片尾曲。佢哋用咗五年做呢套戲。畫工麻麻係因為冇學過畫動畫，但故事有紋有路，仲有幾個幾好嘅笑點。我覺得呢套戲唔算爛，只係比預期好少少，但又唔夠出色，算係平庸啫。
levels.text_en: There's a very cheaply made Chinese animated film called 'Niu Lai' (Calf Comes). Many people say it's 'terrible in every way,' and some people even went to the cinema specially to mock it, treating it like performance art. As a result, in just half a month, the box office rose to over 16 million yuan. The film was made by a mother and son: the son originally worked in home renovation and only started making films in 2021; the mother, Sun Lifang, was both the screenwriter and composer, and even sang the ending theme song herself. It took them five years to make this film. The drawing is mediocre because they never studied animation, but the story is coherent and has some pretty good jokes. I don't think this film is terrible—it's just a bit better than expected, but not outstanding either. It's mediocre.

levels.text: 中國有套超低成本嘅動畫戲叫《牛來》，因為劣評如潮，反而吸引一班存心嘲笑嘅大陸觀眾入場打卡，甚至有人話係借戲票搞行為藝術。短短半個月，票房已經升到超過一千六百萬人民幣，好誇張。創作團隊其實只有母子兩人：兒子信雨萌本行做裝修，2021年先正式入行拍戲；母親孫麗芳就身兼編劇同配樂，仲親自唱片尾曲，佢哋用咗五年先完成呢套戲。畫風確實比較樸素，但劇情有紋有路，仲有啲設計得幾好嘅笑點，唔似外界講得咁爛。邁克先生話呢套戲嘅粗糙畫風其實係素人動畫嘅特色，我睇咗盜錄版之後亦有同感。戲入面仲有西洋文學嘅隱喻，貫穿全片嘅雲雀角色其實係來自英國詩人雪萊嘅名作〈致雲雀〉，象徵超脫同理想。可惜編導功力始終有限，戲劇張力唔夠，令人覺得呢套戲唔係「爛」，而係平庸——比預期好，但又未夠出色。
levels.text_en: There's a super low-budget Chinese animated film called 'Niu Lai' (Calf Comes). Because of the flood of negative reviews, it actually attracted a group of mainland Chinese viewers who went specifically to mock it and 'check in,' with some even saying they were using movie tickets to stage performance art. In just half a month, the box office rose to over 16 million yuan, which is quite extraordinary. The creative team actually consists of just a mother and son: the son, Xin Yumeng, originally worked in renovation and only formally entered the film industry in 2021; the mother, Sun Lifang, served as both screenwriter and composer, and even sang the ending theme song herself. It took them five years to complete this film. The art style is indeed quite plain, but the plot is coherent, with some well-designed jokes—it's not as bad as people say. Mr. Mak said that the rough art style is actually characteristic of amateur animation, and after watching a pirated copy, I felt the same way. The film also contains allusions to Western literature—the skylark character that runs throughout the film actually comes from the famous poem 'To a Skylark' by the English poet Shelley, symbolizing transcendence and ideals. Unfortunately, the director's skill is still limited, and the dramatic tension is insufficient, making the film feel not 'terrible' but mediocre—better than expected, but not good enough.

levels.text: 中國有一部成本極低的動畫電影《牛來》，因為評價極差，反而吸引大批只想嘲笑的觀眾入場，令票房在半個月內急升至逾一千六百萬人民幣。這部電影其實由一對母子製作：兒子信雨萌本來從事裝修，二零二一年才轉行拍電影；母親孫麗芳則同時擔任編劇和配樂，並親自演唱片尾曲，二人花了五年時間完成作品。畫面雖然簡陋，但故事結構完整，對白也不差，並不如外界所說的那麼差。片中的雲雀角色更暗含英國詩人雪萊名作〈致雲雀〉的意象，象徵理想和自由。可惜導演功力不足，戲劇張力有限，故事雖然不算爛片，卻只是平庸之作。
levels.text_en: There is an extremely low-budget Chinese animated film called 'Niu Lai' (Calf Comes). Because of extremely poor reviews, it instead attracted large numbers of viewers who just wanted to mock it, causing the box office to rapidly rise to over 16 million yuan within half a month. The film was actually made by a mother and son: the son, Xin Yumeng, originally worked in renovation and only switched to filmmaking in 2021; the mother, Sun Lifang, served as both screenwriter and composer, and personally sang the ending theme song. The two of them spent five years completing the work. Although the visuals are crude, the story structure is complete and the dialogue isn't bad—it's not as poor as outsiders claim. The skylark character in the film even carries the imagery of English poet Shelley's famous work 'To a Skylark,' symbolizing ideals and freedom. Unfortunately, the director's skill is insufficient and the dramatic tension is limited, so although the story isn't a terrible film, it is only a mediocre work.

levels.text_en:
Described by many as 'terrible in every way,' the ultra-low-budget Chinese animated film 'Niu Lai' (Calf Comes) has recently, due to a tsunami of negative reviews, instead attracted a group of mainland Chinese viewers intent on mocking it, going to 'check in'—as some put it, using movie tickets to stage performance art. As a result, within just half a month, the box office miraculously surged a thousandfold to over 16 million yuan, becoming quite a spectacle.

Checking into the creative team's background, the core members are just a mother and son. The son originally worked in renovation and only formally entered the film industry in 2021. In an age when AI can generate Hollywood-style blockbuster scenes with one click, the two of them instead returned to 'handmade' tradition, spending five years making 'Niu Lai.' The visuals were handled by Xin Yumeng, who never studied animation, while the mother, Sun Lifang, served as both screenwriter and composer, and even personally sang the ending theme song. If this information isn't fabricated, their struggle story is actually rather inspiring.

I hadn't originally planned to watch this peculiar film, but yesterday Mr. Mak messaged me saying he felt the rough art style of 'Niu Lai' wasn't really a problem, because that's simply characteristic of amateur animation. This made me curious enough to skim through a pirated copy online. The art style is indeed plain, but the plot is coherent, and there are even some pretty good comedic moments (meaning jokes designed by the screenwriter, not the audience's mockery)—nothing like as bad as outsiders say. In fact, it left me, someone determined to 'challenge a hellishly bad film,' somewhat disappointed.

The story of 'Niu Lai,' simply put, is about a newborn calf named Niu Lai who has a very, very long dream. In the dream, guided by a skylark, it overcomes many difficulties and dangers, eventually growing strong and becoming a cow brave enough to face the world. Although the script was written by the completely inexperienced Sun Lifang, the dialogue isn't bad at all. For example, there's a scene where the mother cow leaps across a river; Niu Lai doesn't yet have enough strength, so the mother cow encourages it to bravely jump across. Their exchange goes like this:

Niu Lai: Let me jump after I grow up.
Mother cow: Growing up is a matter of the future.
Niu Lai: How far away is the future?
Mother cow: Today is yesterday's future.
Niu Lai: But I don't feel that I've grown up more today than yesterday.
Mother cow: Growing up is a gradual accumulation, hard to notice in a short time. If you jump over a stream today, and a big river tomorrow, then the day after tomorrow you'll dare to brave rapids and dangerous shoals. By then you will truly have grown up.

I think the line 'today is yesterday's future' is really well written. 'Niu Lai' has a complete story and quite a few metaphors. What surprised me most is that it even embeds a Western literary allusion—the most obvious being the skylark character that runs through the whole film, guiding Niu Lai's growth. The skylark, as a symbol of transcendence and ideals, is of course not a product of Chinese culture, but comes from the famous poem 'To a Skylark' by the English Romantic poet Shelley.

In Shelley's poem, the skylark, whose song sounds heavenly, is called a 'blithe Spirit,' transcending all worldly sorrows, symbolizing the ascension of the soul and the spirit of freedom—an ideal realm the poet longs for:

Higher still and higher
From the earth thou springest
Like a cloud of fire

(translated: 再高，再高，從地上升起，像一朵火雲)

The mainland Chinese viewers who mock 'Niu Lai' as terrible in every way are probably mostly a generation raised on Xiaohongshu and Douyin short videos—how many of them have read 'To a Skylark' or even heard of Shelley? If we understand the film as a coming-of-age story about 'bravely pursuing one's ideals,' I think it makes complete sense. Unfortunately, the director still lacks finesse, and the dramatic tension is insufficient to move audiences, so the film's real problem isn't that it's 'terrible'—it's that it's mediocre: better than expected, but not good enough.

For an amateur animated film, 'Niu Lai' isn't a terrible film, and it's certainly not a cult film either. To put it bluntly, its viral popularity is only...

articles.summary_en: The article discusses a super-low-budget Chinese animated film called '牛來' (Niu Lai, about a calf), which became a surprise box-office hit after being widely mocked online; the author (Michael Fung / 馮睎乾) examines the film made by a mother-and-son team and finds unexpected literary echoes of Shelley's poem 'To a Skylark'.

articles.title: 玩謝M&M與橙皮的食物攝影師　超整齊排列寫真治癒31萬Followers
articles.summary: 有個外國攝影師鍾意將食物同日常物品整齊咁排列嚟影靚相，好多人睇到都覺得好舒服。

levels.text: 有個外國攝影師叫Adam Hillman，佢鍾意將啲食物同日常物品排到好整齊先影相。佢會用M&M朱古力豆、蔥花、生果同棒棒糖嚟砌靚圖案，睇落好舒服。佢今年先24歲，喺Instagram已經有31萬人追蹤佢。
levels.text_en: There's a foreign photographer named Adam Hillman who likes to arrange food and everyday objects very neatly before taking photos. He uses M&M chocolate beans, chopped scallions, fruit, and lollipops to create pretty patterns that look very soothing. He's only 24 years old this year, and already has 310,000 followers on Instagram.

levels.text: 外國有個叫Adam Hillman嘅攝影師，好鍾意將日常食物同物品排到好整齊嚟影相，睇落好治癒。佢會用M&M朱古力豆、蔥花、生果、木條同棒棒糖嚟砌出五顏六色嘅圖案，每個作品都係佢自己親手慢慢排出嚟。雖然佢今年先得24歲，但已經因為呢啲「強迫症治癒照片」喺網上爆紅，Instagram帳戶而家有超過31萬人追蹤。鍾意攝影嘅朋友，不妨追蹤佢嘅IG，睇下呢啲靚相嚟放鬆一下。
levels.text_en: There's a foreign photographer named Adam Hillman who loves arranging everyday food and objects very neatly to take photos, which looks very healing. He uses M&M chocolate beans, chopped scallions, fruit, wooden sticks, and lollipops to create colorful patterns, with each piece slowly arranged by his own hands. Although he's only 24 years old this year, he has already gone viral online for these "OCD-healing photos," and his Instagram account now has over 310,000 followers. Friends who like photography might want to follow his IG to relax by looking at these lovely photos.

levels.text: 美國攝影師Adam Hillman專注於排列同順序美感嘅創作，作品風格獨特，善用生活中常見嘅平凡物品，例如裝住唔同顏色液體嘅紙杯、M&M朱古力豆、蔥花同棒棒糖，將佢哋整整齊齊咁排列，再拍成照片。佢仲會用木條嘅長短組合，砌出令人驚喜嘅圖案，甚至喺單調嘅食物排列上加入色彩設計，創造出屬於自己獨一無二嘅「強迫症治癒照片」。今年先24歲嘅佢，係相當年輕嘅新興攝影師，憑住呢一系列舒壓整齊排列寫真喺網上迅速走紅，目前Instagram已經擁有超過31萬名追蹤者。如果你都鍾意呢種風格嘅攝影作品，不妨追蹤佢嘅IG，隨時透過呢啲完美嘅照片嚟紓緩壓力。
levels.text_en: American photographer Adam Hillman focuses on creating art centered on arrangement and orderly aesthetics. His work has a distinctive style, skillfully using common everyday objects — such as paper cups holding different colored liquids, M&M chocolate beans, chopped scallions, and lollipops — arranging them neatly and then photographing them. He also uses combinations of wooden sticks of different lengths to create surprising patterns, and even adds color design to otherwise monotonous food arrangements, creating his own unique "OCD-healing photos." At only 24 years old this year, he is a fairly young up-and-coming photographer who has quickly gone viral online with this series of stress-relieving, neatly arranged photography. He currently has over 310,000 followers on Instagram. If you also like this style of photography, you might want to follow his IG to relieve stress anytime through these perfect photos.

levels.text: 美國攝影師Adam Hillman擅長把日常物品排列得整整齊齊，再拍成照片。他常用M&M朱古力豆、蔥花、生果和棒棒糖等材料，創作出色彩繽紛又治癒的圖案。他今年只有24歲，卻已憑這些「強迫症治癒照片」在網上走紅，目前Instagram追蹤人數超過31萬。喜歡這類攝影風格的人，可以追蹤他的IG，欣賞更多作品。
levels.text_en: American photographer Adam Hillman is skilled at arranging everyday objects very neatly and then photographing them. He often uses materials like M&M chocolate beans, chopped scallions, fruit, and lollipops to create colorful, healing patterns. He is only 24 years old this year, but has already gone viral online with these "OCD-healing photos," and currently has over 310,000 followers on Instagram. People who like this style of photography can follow his IG to see more of his work.

levels.text: Adam Hillman是一位專注於排列順序、整齊美的藝術家。從裝著不同顏色液體的堆疊紙杯，到下面這一盤 M&M's朱古力豆，所有攝影作品的主題幾乎都是由他本人親自慢慢排列而成的。 點擊圖片，即睇超整齊、超治癒的食物攝影▼ Adam Hillman 非常善用於一般人生活中時常運用到、進食到的平凡物品來進行排列擺拍，同時Adam 的系列作品也與眾不同，他非常喜歡在單調的食物排列上進行一些顏色的設計改造，創作出自己獨一無二的「強迫症治癒照片」。從蔥花到一支支夢幻糖果色彩的棒棒糖，他還會利用木條的長短組合出一個令人驚喜的圖陣。 單單是生果，Adam Hillman就可以玩出豐富的創意。事實上今年才 24 歲的他是相當年輕的新興攝影師，因為樂於在網上向Fans提供這一系列「舒壓整齊排列寫真」而開始走紅，目前他的 Instagram 已經擁有超過 31 萬Follwers。如果你也喜歡攝影師Adam Hillman的創作，不妨追蹤他的 IG來讓自己可以不時藉由這位攝影師的完美照片紓壓一下。 【本文獲「 JUKSY街星 」授權轉載。】
levels.text_en: Adam Hillman is an artist focused on arrangement, order, and neat aesthetics. From stacked paper cups filled with different colored liquids to a plate of M&M's chocolate beans shown below, almost all the subjects of his photographic works are slowly arranged by himself personally. Click the image to see these incredibly neat, incredibly healing food photography works ▼ Adam Hillman makes excellent use of ordinary objects that people commonly use and eat in daily life to create his arranged shots. At the same time, Adam's series of works stands out from others — he loves adding color design transformations to otherwise monotonous food arrangements, creating his own unique "OCD-healing photos." From chopped scallions to rows of dreamy candy-colored lollipops, he also uses combinations of wooden sticks of different lengths to form surprising patterns. With fruit alone, Adam Hillman can display abundant creativity. articles.title: 一名14歲少年涉嫌虐待貓隻致死被捕
articles.summary: 一個14歲男仔虐待同學托佢睇嘅貓，令隻貓死咗，佢就俾警方拉咗。

levels.text: 警方拉咗一個14歲男仔，話佢喺屋企虐待人哋托佢睇嘅貓。隻貓係佢同學嘅，同學走咗去外國，叫佢幫手睇住。佢喺屋企掌摑同踢隻貓，隻貓好傷，帶去獸醫度睇，最後都係死咗。獸醫覺得貓可能俾人虐待過，就報咗警。
levels.text_en: Police arrested a 14-year-old boy, saying he abused at home a cat he was asked to look after. The cat belonged to his classmate, who had gone abroad and asked him to help take care of it. He slapped and kicked the cat at home, badly hurting it. It was taken to a vet, but eventually died. The vet thought the cat might have been abused, so reported it to police.

levels.text: 警方拘捕咗一名14歲男仔，懷疑佢喺屋企虐待受託照顧嘅貓隻，令貓死亡。事發喺深水埗，警方接獲一間獸醫診所報案，話有人帶住一隻8個月大嘅灰白色長毛貓求醫，檢查後發現貓隻口鼻有血、全身濕晒仲有腹部積水，之後證實已經死咗。獸醫懷疑隻貓曾經俾人虐待。調查之後發現，隻貓其實係被捕男仔嘅同學嘅，因為同學暫時離開香港，就交俾佢照顧。點知佢喺長沙灣屋企掌摑同踢隻貓，最後警方以「殘酷對待動物」拘捕咗佢，案件交由深水埗警區跟進。
levels.text_en: Police arrested a 14-year-old boy, suspected of abusing at home a cat entrusted to his care, causing the cat's death. The incident happened in Sham Shui Po, where police received a report from a vet clinic that someone had brought in an 8-month-old grey-and-white long-haired cat for treatment. After examination, the cat was found to have blood around its mouth and nose, was soaked all over, and had fluid buildup in its abdomen; it was later confirmed dead. The vet suspected the cat had been abused. Investigation revealed the cat actually belonged to the arrested boy's classmate, who had temporarily left Hong Kong and left the cat in his care. It turned out he slapped and kicked the cat at his home in Cheung Sha Wan. Police arrested him on suspicion of "cruelty to animals," and the case has been handed to Sham Shui Po Police District for follow-up.

levels.text: 警方於上周一拘捕一名14歲少年，懷疑佢喺屋企虐待受託照顧嘅貓隻，最終導致貓隻死亡。事件源於深水埗一間獸醫診所嘅獸醫報案，指被捕人帶住一隻8個月大嘅灰白色長毛起司貓求醫。經檢查後，發現貓隻口鼻有血跡、全身濕透，仲有腹部積水，其後證實死亡，獸醫懷疑貓隻曾經遭受殘酷對待。警方調查後發現，該貓隻本屬於被捕人嘅同學，因為同學暫時離港，遂交由被捕人代為照顧。豈料被捕人早前喺長沙灣寓所內，曾經掌摑及踢向貓隻。警方隨即以涉嫌「殘酷對待動物」罪名拘捕該名少年，案件現交由深水埗警區刑事調查支援小隊第二隊跟進調查。
levels.text_en: Police arrested a 14-year-old teenager last Monday, suspected of abusing at home a cat entrusted to his care, ultimately leading to the cat's death. articles.title: 【葉底藏花】柏拉圖的洞，還是莊子的井？ — 告別「AI安全」，走向更開闊的「AI主權」 – 鄒崇銘
articles.summary: 作者話用少數專家去決定AI啱唔啱，好似柏拉圖講嘅「哲王」咁樣，但普通人冇份就唔多啱。

levels.text: 故事入面有個人用VR同莊子講柏拉圖嘅山洞故仔，話人淨係見到山洞入面嘅影，睇唔到真嘅嘢。莊子話呢個同佢自己講嘅井底之蛙好似，但佢話冇絕對嘅真同假，井都啱蛙住，海都啱龜住。而家啲科技公司請哲學家嚟教AI乜嘢係啱嘅，作者話呢個好似柏拉圖講嗰個「哲王」，即係少數專家話晒事，但莊子會話呢啲人都唔代表到所有人。
levels.text_en: In the story, someone uses VR to tell Zhuangzi Plato's cave story, saying people only see shadows in the cave and can't see the real things. Zhuangzi says this is similar to his own story about the frog at the bottom of a well, but he says there's no absolute truth or falsehood — the well suits the frog, and the sea suits the turtle. Nowadays tech companies hire philosophers to teach AI what's right, and the author says this is like Plato's 'philosopher king' — a few experts deciding everything — but Zhuangzi would say these people don't represent everyone.

levels.text: 在《Demotopia》呢個故仔入面，VR版嘅王充向莊子講咗柏拉圖嘅「山洞寓言」：人俾困喺山洞入面，淨係見到光線照喺洞壁嘅影，只有哲人先可以行出去見到真嘅世界。莊子話呢個同佢自己講嘅「井底之蛙」好接近，不過佢認為冇絕對嘅真定假，海龜見到嘅大海同井蛙見到嘅井底都各有各嘅道理，井可能正正係最啱蛙住嘅地方。如果所有人都要接受同一種真理，咁真理就唔再係真理，仲會變成最沉重嘅枷鎖。作者話而家啲科技公司請哲學家嚟幫AI定道德規範，同柏拉圖講嘅「哲王」好相似——由少數專家決定影響全人類嘅嘢，但普通人就冇份參與。
levels.text_en: In the story 'Demotopia,' a VR version of Wang Chong tells Zhuangzi Plato's 'Allegory of the Cave': people are trapped in a cave, only seeing shadows cast on the cave wall by light, and only philosophers can walk out and see the real world. Zhuangzi says this is very close to his own story of the 'frog at the bottom of a well,' but he believes there's no absolute truth or falsehood — the sea seen by the turtle and the bottom of the well seen by the frog each have their own validity, and the well might be exactly the right place for the frog to live. If everyone had to accept the same single truth, then truth would no longer be truth, but would become the heaviest shackle. The author says that nowadays tech companies hiring philosophers to help set moral standards for AI is very similar to Plato's 'philosopher king' — a few experts deciding things that affect all of humanity, while ordinary people have no part in it.

levels.text: 在《Demotopia》呢個故事入面，配備現代資料庫嘅VR版王充，向莊子轉述咗柏拉圖著名嘅「洞穴寓言」：人類就好似被困喺洞穴入面嘅囚徒，只能夠見到外面光線投射喺洞壁上嘅影，只有哲人先可以走出洞穴，見到真實嘅世界。莊子回應話，呢種寓言其實同佢講嘅「井底之蛙」頗為接近，只不過一個發生喺洞穴，一個喺井底。佢強調冇絕對嘅真實同大小，海龜見到嘅大海，同井蛙見到嘅井底，都各自啱哂——井底可能正正係最適合蛙生活嘅地方。如果所有人都要被逼接受同一種真理，真理就唔再係真理，反而會成為人類史上最沉重嘅枷鎖。作者由呢個故仔諗到而家「AI安全」嘅討論——科技巨頭請哲學家嚟幫AI建立道德規範，呢啲情況同柏拉圖構思嘅「哲王」極為相似：由一小撮專家去決定影響全人類嘅道德標準，普通市民就因為冇專業知識而被排除喺決策之外。作者話莊子大概會質疑，即使哲王有超凡智慧，都唔代表佢哋自然有正當性去代表其他所有人作決定。
levels.text_en: In the story 'Demotopia,' a VR version of Wang Chong, equipped with a modern database, relates to Zhuangzi Plato's famous 'Allegory of the Cave': humanity is like prisoners trapped in a cave, able to see only shadows cast on the cave wall by light from outside, and only philosophers can walk out of the cave and see the real world. Zhuangzi responds that this parable is actually quite close to his own story of the 'frog at the bottom of a well,' the only difference being one happens in a cave and the other at the bottom of a well. He emphasizes there is no absolute truth or size — the sea seen by the turtle and the bottom of the well seen by the frog are each equally valid — the bottom of the well might be exactly the place most suited for the frog to live. If everyone were forced to accept the same single truth, truth would no longer be truth, but would instead become the heaviest shackle in human history. From this story the author reflects on today's discussions of 'AI safety' — tech giants hiring philosophers to help establish moral norms for AI, a situation extremely similar to Plato's concept of the 'philosopher king': a small group of experts deciding moral standards that affect all humanity, while ordinary citizens, lacking professional knowledge, are excluded from the decision-making. The author says Zhuangzi would probably question this: even if philosopher kings possess extraordinary wisdom, that doesn't mean they naturally have the legitimacy to make decisions on behalf of everyone else.

levels.text: 在《Demotopia》這個故事裡，配備現代資料庫的VR版王充，向莊子講述了柏拉圖著名的「洞穴寓言」：人被困在洞穴中，只能看見洞壁上的影子，只有哲人才能走出洞穴看見真實世界。莊子回應說，這和他的「井底之蛙」很相似，分別只在於一個在洞穴、一個在井底。他認為沒有絕對的真實，海龜見到的大海和井蛙見到的井底同樣真實，井底可能正是最適合蛙生活的地方。如果所有人都要接受同一種真理，真理就會變成最沉重的枷鎖。作者由此聯想到現在的「AI安全」討論：科技公司聘請哲學家為AI制定道德規範，這和柏拉圖構想的「哲王」十分相似——由少數專家決定影響全人類的道德標準，普通人卻因缺乏專業知識而被排除在外。作者指出，莊子大概會質疑：即使這些「哲王」擁有超凡智慧，也不代表他們有正當性代表所有人作決定。歷史上，政治權威常常建基於「擁有更高知識」，但現代民主制度已經徹底改變了這種傳統。
levels.text_en: In the story 'Demotopia,' a VR version of Wang Chong, equipped with a modern database, tells Zhuangzi Plato's famous 'Allegory of the Cave': people are trapped in a cave, able to see only shadows on the cave wall, and only philosophers can walk out of the cave to see the real world. Zhuangzi responds that this is very similar to his own 'frog at the bottom of a well,' the only difference being one happens in a cave and the other in a well. He believes there is no absolute reality — the sea seen by the turtle and the bottom of the well seen by the frog are equally real, and the bottom of the well might be exactly the place most suited for the frog to live. If everyone had to accept the same single truth, truth would become the heaviest shackle. From this the author is reminded of today's discussions of 'AI safety': tech companies hiring philosophers to set moral norms for AI, which is very similar to Plato's concept of the 'philosopher king' — a small group of experts deciding moral standards affecting all of humanity, while ordinary people are excluded due to lacking professional knowledge. The author points out that Zhuangzi would probably question this: even if these 'philosopher kings' possess extraordinary wisdom, that doesn't mean they have the legitimacy to make decisions on behalf of everyone. Historically, political authority was often built on claims of 'possessing superior knowledge,' but modern democratic systems have thoroughly transformed this tradition.

levels.text: 在《Demotopia》的故事中，VR版本的古代中國哲學家王充，由於配備了現代資料庫，向莊子轉述了柏拉圖著名的「洞穴寓言」（Allegory of the Cave）。簡而言之，柏拉圖把人類比喻成被困鎖在洞穴中的囚徒，只能看見外界光線投射在洞壁上的影子。只有哲人能夠走出洞穴，看見外面的真實世界，再回到啟蒙仍然困於洞中的囚徒。 莊子大約比柏拉圖晚生60年，兩人分別身處歐亞大陸的兩端，都是二千多年前「軸心時代」的主要思想家。在《Demotopia》中，「VR莊子」在聽過「VR王充」講述柏拉圖這寓言後，你試猜猜，他又會作何回應？ 「VR莊子」說：「這種寓言，其實和我的『井底之蛙』頗為接近，分別只在於一種發生在洞穴、一種在井底。當然，我從來沒有說過，海龜看見的大海就是終極真實，而井蛙看見的井底世界就不真實。宇宙間還有比海廣闊得多的世界，也有比井底細微得多的風景。一切都是相對的——沒有絕對的大小，也沒有絕對的真實。井底可能正是最適合蛙生活的地方，就像大海最適合龜一樣。 「當所有人人都必須接受同一種真理，真理便不再是真理。它將成為人類歷史鑄造過最沉重的枷鎖。」（《Demotopia》，頁163） 不戴皇冠的當代「哲王」 最近我重新想起這段文字，是因為當下世界正愈益被「AI安全」（AI safety）的論述所主導。 近期媒體不時報道，科技巨頭為了聘用工程師，也開始聘請哲學家，幫助最前沿的AI模型建立道德規範和磨合策略。 隨著AI很可能於不久將來，將會在眾多領域超越人類智慧，由這些模型作出的決策，將可能對人類未來產生極為深遠的影響。如何避免災難性的後果，當即成為當代AI治理的核心議題。 這些想像與柏拉圖的政治構想，有著極其驚人的相似之處。這並不是說「AI安全」的出發點有錯，也不是說參與其中的專家必然不值得信任。真正的問題在於，它往往假定一小撮的專家——AI研究者、哲學家和科技精英——應該負責界定最終可能影響數十億人的模型，及其背後的道德基礎。相對而言，普通公民既缺乏相關科技知識，也沒有深厚的哲學訓練，遂被認定難以在這些重大決策中，扮演任何有意義的角色。 如此一來，這其實已很接近柏拉圖想像中的「哲王」（philosopher king）。這種時代的「哲王」不再頭戴皇冠，他們撰寫AI倫理綱領；他們的權威並非來自政治崗位，而是來自專業知識。然而，莊子大概仍會提出異議——不是因為這些哲王不夠智慧，也不是因為他們注定腐化、最終背叛我們。他的質疑將會更為根本：即使「哲王」擁有超凡的知識和智慧，也不代表他們自然能代表其他所有人——在認知、判斷和作出決定時具備正當性。 在人類歷史的大部分時間，無論東方還是西方，政治權威往往建基於號稱「擁有更高知識」——無論是哲王、睿智領袖、士大夫、祭司階層，還是技術官僚精英皆莫不如此。但很可惜，在近二百多年，現代憲政民主已對這種傳統進行了徹底顛覆。顯而易見
levels.text_en: In the story 'Demotopia,' a VR version of the ancient Chinese philosopher Wang Chong, equipped with a modern database, relates to Zhuangzi Plato's famous 'Allegory of the Cave.' In brief, Plato compares humanity to prisoners trapped in a cave, able only to see shadows cast on the cave wall by light from outside. Only the philosopher can walk out of the cave, see the real world outside, and then return to enlighten the prisoners still trapped inside. Zhuangzi was born roughly 60 years after Plato, and though the two lived at opposite ends of the Eurasian continent, both were major thinkers of the 'Axial Age' over two thousand years ago. In 'Demotopia,' after 'VR Zhuangzi' hears 'VR Wang Chong' relate Plato's parable, how do you suppose he responds? 'VR Zhuangzi' says: 'This parable is actually quite close to my own story of the frog at the bottom of the well — the only difference being one happens in a cave, the other in a well. Of course, I never said that the sea seen by the turtle is the ultimate reality, while the world at the bottom of the well seen by the frog is unreal. There are worlds in the universe far vaster than the sea, and also scenes far more minute than the bottom of a well. Everything is relative — there is no absolute size, no absolute reality. The bottom of the well might be exactly the place most suited for the frog to live, just as the sea is most suited for the turtle. When everyone is forced to accept the same single truth, truth is no longer truth. It becomes the heaviest shackle ever forged in human history.' (Demotopia, p.163) A crownless contemporary 'philosopher king' Recently I've been reminded of this passage again, because the world today is increasingly dominated by discourse on 'AI safety.' Media reports have noted that tech giants, in addition to hiring engineers, have begun hiring philosophers to help the most cutting-edge AI models establish moral norms and behavioral strategies. As AI is very likely to surpass human intelligence in many fields in the near future, decisions made by these models could have extremely far-reaching effects on humanity's future. How to avoid catastrophic outcomes has become a core issue in contemporary AI governance. These imaginings bear a strikingly close resemblance to Plato's political vision. This is not to say that the starting point of 'AI safety' is wrong, nor that the experts involved are necessarily untrustworthy. The real problem lies in the fact that it often assumes a small group of experts — AI researchers, philosophers, and tech elites — should be responsible for defining models, and the moral foundations behind them, that may ultimately affect billions of people. By comparison, ordinary citizens, lacking both relevant technical knowledge and deep philosophical training, are deemed unable to play any meaningful role in these major decisions. In this way, this comes very close to Plato's imagined 'philosopher king.' The 'philosopher kings' of this era no longer wear crowns; they write AI ethics charters; their authority comes not from political office, but from professional expertise. Yet Zhuangzi would probably still raise objections — not because these philosopher kings lack wisdom, nor because they are destined to become corrupt and eventually betray us. His challenge would be more fundamental: even if 'philosopher kings' possess extraordinary knowledge and wisdom, that doesn't mean they naturally have the legitimacy to represent everyone else — in cognition, judgment, and decision-making. For most of human history, in both East and West, political authority was often built on claims of 'possessing superior knowledge' — whether philosopher kings, wise leaders, scholar-officials, priestly classes, or technocratic elites, all were the same in this respect. articles.title: 【台灣旅遊】九份、愛河之心、陽明山　網民票選10大至靚浪漫夜景
articles.summary: 台灣網民票選出十大浪漫夜景，呢篇文講埋台北101、新北烘爐地同台中望高寮呢三個地方。

levels.text: 台灣網民選咗十個靚夜景，呢篇文講第十到第八名。第十係台北101觀景台，企喺91樓睇成個城市好靚。第九係新北中和烘爐地，嗰度有廟，又可以睇到101同文化大學。第八係台中望高寮夜景公園，可以睇晒台中同彰化，仲可以去藍色公路拍拖。
levels.text_en: Taiwanese netizens picked ten beautiful night views; this article talks about ranks 10 to 8. Number 10 is the Taipei 101 Observatory, standing on the 91st floor you can see the whole city looking very beautiful. Number 9 is Hongludi in Zhonghe, New Taipei, there's a temple there, and you can also see 101 and Culture University. Number 8 is Wanggaoliao Night View Park in Taichung, where you can see all of Taichung and Changhua, and you can also go to the Blue Highway for a date.

levels.text: 台灣網民票選十大浪漫夜景，呢篇文講第十到第八名。第十係台北101觀景台，91樓嘅360度觀景台可以睇晒成個台北市，好似阿拉丁同茉莉坐飛毯咁浪漫。第九係新北中和烘爐地，嗰度有間好出名嘅南山福德宮，除咗拜神仲可以喺觀景台睇到101大樓同文化大學嘅夜景。第八係台中望高寮夜景公園，政府起咗廣場同觀景台，畀人睇台中同彰化嘅靚景，睇完仲可以去藍色公路散步拍拖。文章仲提到九份、陽明山竹子湖同象山排喺頭七位。
levels.text_en: Taiwanese netizens voted for the top 10 romantic night views; this article covers ranks 10 to 8. Number 10 is the Taipei 101 Observatory — the 360-degree observatory on the 91st floor lets you see the whole of Taipei City, romantic like Aladdin and Jasmine riding a flying carpet. Number 9 is Hongludi in Zhonghe, New Taipei, where there's a very famous temple called Nanshan Fude Temple; besides worshipping, you can also see the night views of 101 and Culture University from the observation deck. Number 8 is Wanggaoliao Night View Park in Taichung — the government built a plaza and observation deck there so people can see the beautiful views of Taichung and Changhua, and afterwards you can go for a walk and date at the Blue Highway. The article also mentions that Jiufen, Zhuzihu on Yangmingshan, and Xiangshan ranked in the top 7.

levels.text: 根據台灣網民票選，最浪漫嘅十大夜景之中，呢篇報導詳細講述第十至第八名。第十名係台北101觀景台，位於91樓嘅360度觀景台可以俯瞰成個城市，燈火絢爛，令人聯想起阿拉丁同茉莉坐飛毯遊覽城市嘅浪漫畫面。第九名係新北中和烘爐地，區內以南山福德宮最出名，香火鼎盛之餘，喺主殿旁邊仲有觀景平台，可以遠眺101大樓同文化大學，成為情侶流連嘅地方。第八名係台中望高寮夜景公園，位於南屯同大肚交界，係台中觀賞夜景嘅最高點，當地政府特別興建半圓形廣場同木棧道，方便市民欣賞台中、彰化一帶嘅璀璨景色，附近仲有藍色公路可以散步拍拖。文章最後提到，九份、陽明山竹子湖同象山等地方分別排喺首七位。
levels.text_en: According to a vote by Taiwanese netizens, among the ten most romantic night views, this report describes in detail ranks 10 to 8. Rank 10 is the Taipei 101 Observatory — located on the 91st floor, the 360-degree observatory overlooks the entire city, with dazzling lights that evoke the romantic image of Aladdin and Jasmine touring the city on a flying carpet. Rank 9 is Hongludi in Zhonghe, New Taipei, where Nanshan Fude Temple is the most famous, with a constant stream of worshippers; beside the main hall there is also a viewing platform where you can see 101 Tower and Culture University in the distance, making it a favorite spot for couples to linger. Rank 8 is Wanggaoliao Night View Park in Taichung, located at the border of Nantun and Dadu, the highest point in Taichung for viewing night scenery; the local government specially built a semicircular plaza and wooden boardwalk so citizens can enjoy the dazzling views of Taichung and Changhua, and nearby there is also the Blue Highway for walking and dating. The article finally mentions that Jiufen, Zhuzihu on Yangmingshan, and Xiangshan respectively ranked in the top 7.

levels.text: 台灣網友票選出十大浪漫夜景，這篇文章介紹第十至第八名。第十名是台北101觀景台，位於91樓的觀景台可以看到整個台北市的燈光，景色十分美麗。第九名是新北中和烘爐地，那裡的南山福德宮香火很旺，旁邊還有觀景台，可以看到101大樓和文化大學的夜景。第八名是台中望高寮夜景公園，位於南屯和大肚交界，是台中欣賞夜景的最高點，政府建了廣場和步道方便遊客觀賞，附近的藍色公路也是情侶散步的好地方。另外，九份、陽明山竹子湖和象山也在網友票選的前七名之中。

Rank 10 is the Taipei 101 Observatory — the observatory on the 91st floor lets you see the lights of the whole city of Taipei, an extremely beautiful sight. Rank 9 is Hongludi in Zhonghe, New Taipei, where Nanshan Fude Temple has very strong incense (is very popular), and beside it there is also an observation deck where you can see the night views of 101 Tower and Culture University. Rank 8 is Wanggaoliao Night View Park in Taichung, located at the border of Nantun and Dadu, the highest point in Taichung for viewing the night scenery; the government built a plaza and walkway for visitors to enjoy the view, and the nearby Blue Highway is also a great place for couples to walk. In addition, Jiufen, Zhuzihu on Yangmingshan, and Xiangshan are also among the top 7 in the netizens' vote.

levels.text: 10. 台北101觀景台 台灣最具指標性的摩天大樓101，自落成後就吸引全球旅客打卡朝聖，因為其建築高聳入雲，叫人的心情隨快速攀升的電梯，一步步邁向天際！ 接著，當你站在位於91層樓高的360度觀景台上時，無論白天還是黑夜，綿延群山環繞的袖珍市容，以及燈火絢爛的迷幻景緻，絕對令你嘆為觀止！剎那間，你和身旁的學妹，彷彿是乘坐飛毯鳥瞰城市的阿拉丁與茉莉，浪漫氛圍不言而喻。 9. 新北中和烘爐地 聞名遐邇的新北市中和烘爐地，上頭有許多知名廟宇，其中又以「南山福德宮」的香火最為鼎盛，堪稱全台人氣最高的財神廟之一。 不過，這位神通廣大的土地公，除了帶給信徒好運外，似乎還兼職當月老，因為其主殿側門入口處有一座觀景平台，能遠眺大台北百萬夜景，將101大樓與文化大學的美盡收眼底，讓人忍不住駐足於此，沈浸在神明庇佑的寧靜當中，進而流連忘返 8. 台中望高寮夜景公園 位於台中南屯與大肚交界的望高寮公園，因為是台中觀賞夜景的至高點，所以當地政府為了讓民眾能好好享受眼前五光十色，宛如鑽石般璀璨的景象，特地搭建了佔地廣大的半圓形廣場、木棧道與觀景台，吸引一票人入夜後前往，以一覽台中、彰化地區無邊無際之美。 當然，如果你和另一半實在看膩了，也能考慮到一旁藍色公路牽手散心，感受不同的浪漫氣息！ 九份燈籠路、陽明山竹子湖、台北象山…按圖看台灣網友票選首7大浪漫靚絕夜景▼ 延伸閱讀： 渣男渣女「正當式偷情」你敢信？30大最夯台劇 鄉民真的有正義！十大網友熱血爆棚行動 【本文由「 DailyView網路溫度計 」授權轉載，研究資料由「 KEYPO大數據關鍵引擎 」提供。】
levels.text_en: 10. Taipei 101 Observatory: Taiwan's most iconic skyscraper, 101, has attracted tourists from around the world to check in and pay homage since its completion, because its towering architecture makes your mood rise step by step toward the sky along with the fast-climbing elevator! Then, when you stand on the 360-degree observatory on the 91st floor, whether day or night, the miniature cityscape surrounded by rolling mountains and the dazzling, dreamlike scenery of lights will absolutely leave you amazed! In that instant, you and the junior schoolmate beside you seem like Aladdin and Jasmine riding a flying carpet, bird's-eye viewing the city — the romantic atmosphere needs no words. 9. Hongludi in Zhonghe, New Taipei: The famous Hongludi in Zhonghe, New Taipei City has many well-known temples on it, among which Nanshan Fude Temple has the strongest incense (most worshippers), ranking as one of the most popular God of Wealth temples in all of Taiwan. However, this all-powerful Earth God, besides bringing good luck to believers, seems to also moonlight as the Matchmaker God, because at the side entrance of the main hall there is a viewing platform where you can gaze into the distance at the million-dollar night view of greater Taipei, taking in the beauty of 101 Tower and Culture University, making people unable to help but linger here, immersing in the tranquility of the deity's blessing, and thus reluctant to leave. 8. Wanggaoliao Night View Park in Taichung: Located at the border of Nantun and Dadu in Taichung, Wanggaoliao Park is the highest point in Taichung for viewing night scenery, so the local government, in order to let the public properly enjoy the dazzling, diamond-like scene before their eyes, specially built a large semicircular plaza, wooden boardwalk, and observation deck, attracting many people to visit after dark to take in the boundless beauty of the Taichung and Changhua areas. Of course, if you and your other half really get tired of it, you can also consider going to the nearby Blue Highway to hold hands and stroll, feeling a different kind of romantic atmosphere! articles.title: 荔景於本月第一批白紋伊蚊誘蚊器指數最高　達9.8%
articles.summary: 食環署話荔景嗰度啲蚊指數最高，大家要小心防蚊。

levels.text: 食環署出咗個報告，講吓邊度啲蚊最多。荔景嘅蚊指數最高，有9.8%，跟住係上葵涌7.3%，沙田東6.5%。上葵涌同黃大仙東嘅蚊密度都好高。食環署話會加緊滅蚊，又叫大家自己都要小心防蚊，唔好屋企有積水。
levels.text_en: The FEHD released a report about which areas have the most mosquitoes. Lai King has the highest mosquito index, at 9.8%, followed by Shek Wai Kok at 7.3%, and Sha Tin East at 6.5%. Shek Wai Kok and Wong Tai Sin East also have very high mosquito density. The FEHD said it will step up mosquito control efforts, and reminded everyone to take precautions themselves, such as not letting stagnant water collect at home.

levels.text: 食環署公布咗本月第一批白紋伊蚊嘅誘蚊器指數，一共有10個地區。荔景嘅指數最高，達9.8%；跟住係上葵涌7.3%，同埋沙田東6.5%。而上葵涌同黃大仙東嘅密度指數就最高，都係1.5。食環署話而家係雨季，會開會協調各部門，加強控蚊，例如巡查、清除蚊子滋生地方、噴藥殺蚊，同埋擺捕蚊器。佢哋亦都提醒市民要自己做好防蚊措施，例如檢查屋企啲嘢，尤其係擺喺戶外嘅，唔好有積水。
levels.text_en: The FEHD announced the first batch of this month's Aedes albopictus mosquito trap index, covering 10 districts in total. Lai King had the highest index, reaching 9.8%; followed by Shek Wai Kok at 7.3%, and Sha Tin East at 6.5%. As for the density index, Shek Wai Kok and Wong Tai Sin East were the highest, both at 1.5. The FEHD said that since it is currently the rainy season, it will hold meetings to coordinate with various departments to strengthen mosquito control, such as patrols, clearing mosquito breeding sites, spraying insecticide, and placing mosquito traps. They also reminded the public to take their own mosquito prevention measures, such as checking items at home—especially those placed outdoors—to avoid stagnant water.

levels.text: 食環署公布咗本月第一批涵蓋10個監察地區嘅白紋伊蚊誘蚊器指數同密度指數。當中荔景嘅第一階段誘蚊器指數最高，達到9.8%；其次係上葵涌嘅7.3%，同埋沙田東嘅6.5%。至於密度指數方面，上葵涌同黃大仙東就最高，同樣達到1.5嘅水平。發言人表示，喺雨季期間，食環署會持續採取多項防蚊滅蚊措施，包括召開跨部門地區滅蚊專責小組特別會議，協調各相關部門同持份者，全面加強各場地嘅控蚊工作；同時針對蚊患較嚴重嘅地點，實施密集同針對性嘅策略，例如加強巡查、清除現有同潛在嘅蚊子滋生地、施放殺幼蟲劑、霧化殺滅成蚊，以及設置捕蚊器。食環署亦都呼籲市民加強個人防蚊措施，收拾處所，檢查家居用品，尤其係擺喺戶外嘅，避免出現積水，同清除滲漏源頭，減少蚊患。
levels.text_en: The FEHD announced the first batch of this month's Aedes albopictus mosquito trap index and density index, covering 10 monitoring districts. Among them, Lai King had the highest first-phase mosquito trap index, reaching 9.8%; followed by Shek Wai Kok at 7.3%, and Sha Tin East at 6.5%. As for the density index, Shek Wai Kok and Wong Tai Sin East were the highest, both reaching a level of 1.5. A spokesperson said that during the rainy season, the FEHD will continue to adopt multiple mosquito prevention and control measures, including convening special meetings of the inter-departmental district mosquito control task force, coordinating with relevant departments and stakeholders to comprehensively strengthen mosquito control work at various locations. At the same time, for locations with more severe mosquito problems, intensive and targeted strategies will be implemented, such as stepping up patrols, clearing existing and potential mosquito breeding sites, applying larvicide, fogging to kill adult mosquitoes, and setting up mosquito traps. The FEHD also called on the public to strengthen personal mosquito prevention measures, tidy up premises, check household items—especially those placed outdoors—to avoid stagnant water, and eliminate sources of leakage to reduce mosquito problems.

levels.text: 食環署公布了本月第一批白紋伊蚊誘蚊器指數，涵蓋十個監察地區。結果顯示，荔景的指數最高，達到9.8%；其次是上葵涌的7.3%，以及沙田東的6.5%。另外，上葵涌和黃大仙東的密度指數同樣最高，都是1.5。食環署表示，現時正值雨季，會持續採取防蚊措施，包括召開跨部門會議協調各方，加強控蚊工作。對於蚊患較嚴重的地點，會加強巡查、清除蚊子滋生地、噴灑殺蟲劑，以及設置捕蚊器。食環署亦提醒市民要注意個人防蚊，定期檢查家居和戶外用品，避免積水，並清除滲漏源頭，減少蚊子滋生。
levels.text_en: The FEHD announced the first batch of this month's Aedes albopictus mosquito trap index, covering ten monitoring districts. Results showed that Lai King had the highest index, reaching 9.8%; followed by Shek Wai Kok at 7.3%, and Sha Tin East at 6.5%. In addition, Shek Wai Kok and Wong Tai Sin East also had the highest density index, both at 1.5. The FEHD stated that since it is currently the rainy season, it will continue to adopt mosquito prevention measures, including convening inter-departmental meetings to coordinate various parties and strengthen mosquito control work. For locations with more severe mosquito problems, patrols will be stepped up, mosquito breeding sites will be cleared, insecticide will be sprayed, and mosquito traps will be set up. The FEHD also reminded the public to pay attention to personal mosquito prevention, regularly check household and outdoor items, avoid stagnant water, and eliminate sources of leakage to reduce mosquito breeding.

levels.text: 食環署公布本月第一批涵蓋10個監察地區的白紋伊蚊誘蚊器指數及密度指數，其中荔景的第一階段誘蚊器指數最高，達9.8%，其次是上葵涌的7.3%及沙田東的6.5%；至於上葵涌和黃大仙東的第一階段密度指數最高，同樣達1.5水平。 發言人表示，在雨季期間，食環署會持續採取多項防蚊滅蚊措施，包括召開跨部門地區滅蚊專責小組特別會議，協調各相關部門及持份者，全面加強各場地的控蚊工作；以及針對蚊患較嚴重的地點實施密集且具針對性的控蚊策略，包括加強巡查、清除現有及潛在的蚊子滋生地、施放殺幼蟲劑、以霧化處理殺滅成蚊，以及在合適位置設置捕蚊器。 食環署呼籲市民加強個人防蚊措施，收拾處所，並檢查家居用品、尤其是存放於戶外露天地方的用品，避免出現積水，以及清除積水並消除滲漏源頭，以有效防治蚊患。
levels.text_en: The FEHD announced the first batch of this month's Aedes albopictus mosquito trap index and density index, covering 10 monitoring districts. Among them, Lai King had the highest first-phase mosquito trap index, reaching 9.8%, followed by Shek Wai Kok at 7.3% and Sha Tin East at 6.5%; meanwhile, Shek Wai Kok and Wong Tai Sin East had the highest first-phase density index, both reaching a level of 1.5. A spokesperson said that during the rainy season, the FEHD will continue to adopt multiple mosquito prevention and control measures, including convening special meetings of the inter-departmental district mosquito control task force, coordinating with relevant departments and stakeholders to comprehensively strengthen mosquito control work at various venues; as well as implementing intensive and targeted mosquito control strategies for locations with more severe mosquito problems, including stepping up patrols, clearing existing and potential mosquito breeding sites, applying larvicide, fogging to kill adult mosquitoes, and setting up mosquito traps at suitable locations. The FEHD called on the public to strengthen personal mosquito prevention measures, tidy up premises, and check household items—especially those stored in outdoor open areas—to avoid stagnant water, as well as to clear standing water and eliminate sources of leakage, in order to effectively prevent and control mosquito problems.

articles.summary_en: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department (FEHD) in Hong Kong released mosquito surveillance data (Aedes albopictus index) for various districts, showing where mosquito activity is highest, along with measures being taken to control mosquitoes.

articles.title: 海關機場檢獲約4公斤懷疑大麻花　估計市值約90萬元拘一人
articles.summary: 海關喺機場拉咗一個內地男人，因為佢行李箱入面收埋大約4公斤大麻花，估計值90萬蚊。

levels.text: 海關喺機場拉咗一個廿八歲嘅內地男人，佢喺行李箱入面收埋大麻花，大概有4公斤，市值差唔多90萬蚊。呢個人今日先由泰國曼谷飛返香港，一落機就俾海關人員查到。海關話會繼續打擊販毒，叫大家唔好貪錢幫人運嘢，唔好亂咁幫人攞行李。
levels.text_en: Customs arrested a 28-year-old mainland man at the airport, who had hidden cannabis buds in his suitcase, about 4 kilograms, worth almost 900,000 dollars. This man had just flown back to Hong Kong from Bangkok, Thailand today, and was caught by customs officers as soon as he landed. Customs said they will continue to fight drug trafficking, and told everyone not to be greedy for money and help people transport things, and not to casually help others carry luggage.

levels.text: 海關今日喺機場破咗一單行李藏毒嘅販毒案，喺一個28歲內地男人嘅寄艙行李箱入面，搜出大約4公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值大約90萬元，即場拘捕咗佢。呢個男人今日由泰國曼谷飛到香港，海關人員喺幫佢清關嗰陣發現呢批毒品。海關話會繼續根據情報分析，加強打擊販毒活動，同時提醒市民唔好貪圖金錢利益而參與販毒，亦唔好接受人哋聘請或者委託運送受管制物品出入香港，更加唔好喺唔知道啲嘢係咩嘅情況下，就幫人運送。
levels.text_en: Customs today cracked a drug trafficking case involving drugs hidden in luggage at the airport. In the checked-in suitcase of a 28-year-old mainland man, they found about 4 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds, estimated to be worth about 900,000 dollars, and arrested him on the spot. This man flew from Bangkok, Thailand to Hong Kong today, and customs officers discovered the drugs while clearing him through customs. Customs said they will continue to strengthen their crackdown on drug trafficking activities based on intelligence analysis, and also remind the public not to get involved in drug trafficking for money, not to accept hire or commissions from others to transport controlled items in and out of Hong Kong, and especially not to help transport things for others without knowing what they are.

levels.text: 海關今日在香港國際機場偵破一宗行李藏毒嘅販毒案件，檢獲約4公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約90萬元，並拘捕一名28歲嘅內地男子。被捕人士今日由泰國曼谷飛抵香港，海關人員喺替佢清關嘅過程中，喺佢攜帶嘅寄艙行李箱內發現呢批懷疑毒品，於是將佢拘捕。海關表示，會繼續根據情報分析，加強打擊販運毒品嘅活動，同時呼籲市民提高警覺，切勿因為貪圖金錢利益而參與販毒活動，亦都唔好接受任何人士嘅聘請或者委託，去運送受管制嘅物品進出香港。海關仲提醒，就算未確定物品嘅性質，都唔應該貿然幫人運送，以免誤墮法網。
levels.text_en: Customs today cracked a drug trafficking case involving drugs hidden in luggage at Hong Kong International Airport, seizing about 4 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds estimated to be worth about 900,000 dollars, and arrested a 28-year-old mainland man. The arrested person flew from Bangkok, Thailand to Hong Kong today. Customs officers discovered the suspected drugs in his checked-in suitcase while clearing him through customs, and then arrested him. Customs stated that they will continue to strengthen their crackdown on drug trafficking activities based on intelligence analysis, and at the same time call on the public to stay alert, not to participate in drug trafficking activities for monetary gain, and not to accept hire or commissions from anyone to transport controlled items in and out of Hong Kong. Customs also reminded the public that even if the nature of an item is uncertain, one should not rashly help transport it for others, to avoid unintentionally breaking the law.

levels.text: 海關在機場破獲一宗販毒案。一名二十八歲內地男子今日由泰國曼谷抵港，海關人員為他清關時，在其寄艙行李箱內發現約四公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約九十萬元，隨即將他拘捕。海關表示，將繼續根據情報加強打擊販毒活動。海關並呼籲市民提高警覺，不要為金錢而參與販毒，也不要替人運送管制物品，更不要在不清楚物品性質下貿然幫人運送。
levels.text_en: Customs cracked a drug trafficking case at the airport. A 28-year-old mainland man arrived in Hong Kong from Bangkok, Thailand today. While customs officers were clearing him through customs, they found about 4 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds in his checked-in suitcase, estimated to be worth about 900,000 dollars, and immediately arrested him. Customs said they will continue to strengthen their crackdown on drug trafficking based on intelligence. Customs also called on the public to stay alert, not to participate in drug trafficking for money, not to transport controlled items for others, and especially not to rashly help transport items without knowing their nature.

levels.text: 海關今日在機場偵破一宗行李藏毒的販毒案件，檢獲約4公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約90萬元，拘捕一名28歲內地男子。 被捕人士今日從泰國曼谷飛抵本港。海關人員替他清關時，在他攜同的寄艙行李箱內發現該批懷疑大麻花，將他拘捕。 海關表示，會繼續根據情報分析，加強打擊販運毒品活動，同時呼籲市民提高警覺，切勿貪圖金錢利益而參與販毒活動，不要接受任何人士聘請或委託運送受管制物品進出香港，亦切勿於未確定物品屬性的情況下，貿然協助他人運送。
levels.text_en: Customs today cracked a drug trafficking case involving drugs hidden in luggage at the airport, seizing about 4 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds estimated to be worth about 900,000 dollars, and arrested a 28-year-old mainland man. The arrested person flew to Hong Kong from Bangkok, Thailand today. While clearing him through customs, customs officers discovered the suspected cannabis buds in the checked-in suitcase he was carrying, and arrested him. Customs stated that they will continue to strengthen their crackdown on drug trafficking activities based on intelligence analysis, and at the same time call on the public to stay alert, not to participate in drug trafficking activities for monetary gain, not to accept hire or commissions from anyone to transport controlled items in and out of Hong Kong, and also not to rashly help others transport items when the nature of the items is uncertain.

articles.title: 黃大仙企圖謀殺及自殺案　房屋署稱死者獲批准邨內調遷正等候編配
articles.summary: 黃大仙一座樓發生斬人同跳樓案，房屋署話個死者之前投訴過樓上有狗嘈，仲批咗佢喺邨內搬屋。

levels.text: 黃大仙上邨一座樓今朝發生大事，一個25歲男仔喺𨋢入面畀住喺樓下嘅46歲男人用刀斬傷，跟住嗰個斬人嘅男人喺屋企跳樓死咗。25歲傷者情況好危險。警方話兩個人住上下層，之前有過嘈音投訴。房屋署話死者生前投訴過樓上隻狗好嘈。
levels.text_en: Something big happened this morning at a building in Wong Tai Sin Upper Estate. A 25-year-old guy was slashed with a knife in the lift by a 46-year-old man living downstairs, and then the man who did the slashing jumped from his home and died. The 25-year-old victim is in very dangerous condition. Police say the two lived on floors one above the other and there had been noise complaints before. The Housing Department says the dead man had complained that the dog upstairs was very noisy.

levels.text: 黃大仙上邨昭善樓今朝發生企圖謀殺同自殺案。一個25歲男子喺升降機入面，畀住喺樓下單位嘅46歲男子用刀斬傷。之後嗰個斬人嘅男子懷疑喺住所跳樓死咗，25歲傷者而家情況危殆。警方初步調查話，兩人住上下層，之前曾經涉及嘈音投訴。房屋署話，死者生前曾經向屋邨辦事處投訴，話樓上單位隻狗好嘈。樓上戶主之前有署方批准喺單位養寵物犬。辦事處收到投訴後每次都即刻跟進，包括派人突擊巡查，但都冇聽到狗吠聲。
levels.text_en: An attempted murder and suicide happened this morning at Chiu Sin House in Wong Tai Sin Upper Estate. A 25-year-old man was slashed with a knife in the lift by a 46-year-old man living in the unit downstairs. Afterward the man who did the slashing is suspected of jumping from his home and dying; the 25-year-old victim is now in critical condition. Police initial investigation says the two lived on floors one above the other and had previously been involved in a noise complaint. The Housing Department says the dead man had, while alive, complained to the estate office that the dog in the upstairs unit was very noisy. The upstairs occupant had previously been approved by the department to keep a pet dog in the unit. Each time the office received a complaint it followed up immediately, including sending people for surprise inspections, but they never heard barking.

levels.text: 黃大仙上邨昭善樓今早發生企圖謀殺及自殺案。一名25歲男子喺升降機內，被住喺下層單位嘅46歲男子用刀襲擊。行兇者事後懷疑喺住所從高處墮下死亡，25歲傷者目前情況危殆。警方初步調查後表示，兩人所住單位屬於上下層，曾經涉及噪音投訴。房屋署回覆查詢話，死者生前曾向屋邨辦事處投訴，指上層單位嘅狗發出噪音。上層戶主獲署方批准喺單位內飼養伴侶犬。辦事處接獲投訴後每次都即時跟進，包括派員多次突擊巡查，但都未有聽到狗吠聲或發現噪音滋擾。署方又話，死者是特別需要照顧人士，早前已將個案轉介社署跟進及評估，並喺6月批准佢邨內調遷嘅申請，正等候編配單位。
levels.text_en: An attempted murder and suicide happened this morning at Chiu Sin House in Wong Tai Sin Upper Estate. A 25-year-old man was attacked with a knife in the lift by a 46-year-old man living in the lower unit. The attacker is afterward suspected of having fallen from height at his home and died; the 25-year-old victim is currently in critical condition. After initial investigation police said the two units were on floors one above the other and had been involved in a noise complaint. The Housing Department, replying to inquiries, said the dead man had while alive complained to the estate office that the dog in the upper unit made noise. The upper occupant had been approved by the department to keep a companion dog in the unit. Each time the office received a complaint it followed up immediately, including sending staff for repeated surprise inspections, but they never heard barking or found noise nuisance. The department also said the dead man was a person needing special care, that the case had earlier been referred to the Social Welfare Department for follow-up and assessment, and that in June his application for a transfer within the estate had been approved and was awaiting allocation of a unit.

levels.text: 黃大仙上邨昭善樓今早發生一宗企圖謀殺及自殺案。一名25歲男子在升降機內，被住在下層的46歲男子用刀襲擊。行兇的男子其後懷疑在住所跳樓死亡。25歲傷者目前情況危殆。警方初步調查後指，兩人住在上下層，之前曾有噪音投訴。房屋署回覆表示，死者生前曾投訴上層的狗發出噪音。上層戶主獲批准在單位內養寵物犬。辦事處收到投訴後每次都即時跟進，並多次突擊巡查，但都沒有聽到狗吠聲，也沒有其他鄰居作類似投訴。署方又指，死者是需要特別照顧的人士，早前已將個案轉介社署評估，並在6月批准他邨內調遷的申請，正等候編配單位。署方表示高度關注事件，會全力配合警方調查。
levels.text_en: An attempted murder and suicide happened this morning at Chiu Sin House in Wong Tai Sin Upper Estate. A 25-year-old man was attacked with a knife in the lift by a 46-year-old man living on the floor below. The man who committed the attack is afterward suspected of having jumped from his home and died. The 25-year-old victim is currently in critical condition. After initial investigation police said the two lived on floors one above the other and there had previously been a noise complaint. The Housing Department, in reply, said the dead man had while alive complained that the upstairs dog made noise. The upstairs occupant had been approved to keep a pet dog in the unit. Each time the office received a complaint it followed up immediately and made repeated surprise inspections, but never heard barking, and no other neighbors made similar complaints. The department also said the dead man was a person needing special care, that the case had earlier been referred to the Social Welfare Department for assessment, and that in June his application for a transfer within the estate had been approved and was awaiting allocation of a unit. The department said it was highly concerned about the incident and would fully cooperate with the police investigation.

levels.text: 黃大仙上邨昭善樓上午發生的企圖謀殺及自殺案，一名25歲男子在升降機內，被住在下層單位的一名46歲男子用刀襲擊。行兇者事後懷疑在住所從高處墮下死亡，25歲傷者目前情況危殆。警方初步調查後表示，兩人所住單位屬於上下層，曾經涉及噪音投訴。 房屋署回覆查詢表示，死者生前曾向屋邨辦事處投訴，指上層單位的狗隻發出噪音。上層單位的戶主獲署方批准在單位內飼養伴侶犬。辦事處接獲投訴後，每次均即時跟進，包括派員多次突擊巡查等，均未有聽到狗吠聲或發現噪音滋擾情況，亦未曾接獲其他鄰近住戶作類似投訴。 署方表示，死者是特別需要照顧人士，早前將個案轉介予社署跟進及評估，獲得社署推薦後，已於6月批准邨內調遷申請，並正等候合適單位編配。 署方表示，高度關注事件，並對死者家屬及傷者致以深切慰問，會全力配合警方調查工作。
levels.text_en: Regarding the attempted murder and suicide that happened in the morning at Chiu Sin House in Wong Tai Sin Upper Estate, a 25-year-old man was attacked with a knife in the lift by a 46-year-old man living in the lower unit. The attacker is afterward suspected of having fallen from height at his home and died; the 25-year-old victim is currently in critical condition. After initial investigation police said the two units were on floors one above the other and had been involved in a noise complaint. The Housing Department, replying to inquiries, said the dead man had while alive complained to the estate office that the dog in the upper unit made noise. The occupant of the upper unit had been approved by the department to keep a companion dog in the unit. Each time the office received a complaint it followed up immediately, including sending staff for repeated surprise inspections, but never heard barking or found noise nuisance, and had never received similar complaints from other nearby residents. The department said the dead man was a person needing special care; the case had earlier been referred to the Social Welfare Department for follow-up and assessment, and after obtaining the SWD's recommendation, his application for a transfer within the estate had been approved in June and was awaiting allocation of a suitable unit. The department said it was highly concerned about the incident, extended deep condolences to the dead man's family and the victim, and would fully cooperate with the police investigation.

articles.summary_en: An attempted murder and suicide occurred at Chiu Sin House in Wong Tai Sin Upper Estate, a Hong Kong public housing estate. A 25-year-old man was attacked with a knife in the lift by a 46-year-old man living on the floor below, who then apparently killed himself; the two units had a history of noise complaints.

articles.title: 香港航空今日起至下周一多班航班取消或改期
articles.summary: 因為颱風白海豚，香港航空由今日到下星期一有好多班機取消或者改期。

levels.text: 因為有個颱風叫白海豚，香港航空話由今日開始，一直到下星期一，都會有好多班機取消或者改期。未來兩日，有6班嚟往香港同上海嘅機取消咗。仲有幾班香港去日本沖繩、同埋沖繩返香港嘅機，就改到聽日先飛。如果你受影響，可以上網站再訂位或者退錢。
levels.text_en: Because of a typhoon called Baihaitun (White Dolphin), Hong Kong Airlines says that from today until next Monday, many flights will be cancelled or rescheduled. In the next two days, 6 flights between Hong Kong and Shanghai are cancelled. There are also several flights from Hong Kong to Okinawa, Japan, and from Okinawa back to Hong Kong, which have been changed to depart tomorrow. If you are affected, you can go on the website to rebook or get a refund.

levels.text: 內地話有個颱風叫白海豚，估計聽晚到後日朝早會喺浙江到福建一帶登陸。香港航空表示，因為受白海豚影響，由今日開始，一直到下星期一，都會有好多班機取消或者改期。未來兩日，暫時有6班嚟往香港同上海浦東嘅機要取消。另外今日有兩班香港飛去日本沖繩，同埋兩班由沖繩返香港嘅機，會改到聽日先飛。香港航空又話，受影響嘅機票可以免手續費重新訂位、改航點或者退票，不過只係啱已經確認咗機位嘅機票。
levels.text_en: The mainland says there is a typhoon called Baihaitun, expected to make landfall around the Zhejiang-to-Fujian area tomorrow night to the morning after. Hong Kong Airlines says that because of the effects of Baihaitun, from today until next Monday, many flights will be cancelled or rescheduled. In the next two days, for now 6 flights between Hong Kong and Shanghai Pudong will be cancelled. Also, today two flights from Hong Kong to Okinawa, Japan, and two flights from Okinawa back to Hong Kong, will be changed to depart tomorrow. Hong Kong Airlines also says that affected tickets can be rebooked, have their route changed, or be refunded free of service charges, but only for tickets with already-confirmed seats.

articles.summary: 因為打風，香港快運改咗今日同聽日嘅航班，高鐵今日至下星期一都有幾班車要取消。

levels.text: 因為颱風白海豚，香港快運話已經改咗今日同聽日嘅航班。今明兩日來往香港同寧波嘅兩班機取消咗，而聽日由香港飛去寧波嗰班，就改為下星期一朝早先出發。今日來往香港同日本沖繩、石垣嘅航班，就有4班機要取消。至於高鐵，就有幾班車取消。
levels.text_en: Because of Typhoon White Dolphin, Hong Kong Express says it has changed today's and tomorrow's flights. The two flights between Hong Kong and Ningbo over today and tomorrow are cancelled, and tomorrow's flight from Hong Kong to Ningbo is rescheduled to depart next Monday morning instead. Today's flights between Hong Kong and Okinawa and Ishigaki in Japan have 4 flights cancelled. As for the high-speed rail, several trains are cancelled.

articles.title: 兩名中國公民在泰國遇車禍　一死一傷
articles.summary: 兩個中國人喺泰國踩電單車跌落山，一個死一個傷。

levels.text: 前日有兩個中國人喺泰國一個叫閣蘭島嘅地方踩電單車，行到落斜路段嗰陣，電單車好似控制唔到，跌咗落山，爸爸即刻走咗，個女就受咗傷。警察到場之後將傷者送咗去醫院，死者具體就放喺醫院度，等屋企人嚟認。
levels.text_en: The day before yesterday, two Chinese people were riding a motorbike at a place in Thailand called Koh Larn. When they went down a downhill stretch, the motorbike seemed to go out of control and fell off the hill. The father died right away, and the daughter was injured. After police arrived, they took the injured person to hospital, and the body was kept at the hospital, waiting for the family to come identify it.

levels.text_en: The day before yesterday, a Chinese father and daughter were riding a motorbike at a place near Pattaya, Thailand called Koh Larn. When they went down a downhill stretch, the motorbike was suspected to have gone out of control and fell off a cliff. The father died on the spot, and the daughter was injured. After receiving the report, police went to the scene and took the injured person to hospital. The body was kept at the hospital, waiting for family to identify it. The Chinese embassy in Thailand said that after receiving the news, they had contacted the police and hospital, asking them to do their best to save the injured and to properly preserve the body. They also notified the deceased's relatives in China and will help handle the aftermath.

articles.title: 台東旅遊︳被忽略的台東　6處秘景比宮崎峻的吉卜力動畫世界更美
articles.summary: 台東喺台灣東部，海同山之間有好多靚景，靚到好似宮崎駿動畫世界咁。

levels.text: 台東喺台灣，海同山之間有好多靚景。成功鎮有間細細嘅教堂，好似聖誕卡片咁得意，好多人專登嚟影相。東河鎮有個公車站好靚，好多人專登嚟等車。台東市海邊仲有藝術家用木整嘅小屋，同大海一齊睇好靚。呢啲地方靚到好似動畫入面咁。
levels.text_en: Taitung is in Taiwan, and there are many beautiful views between the sea and the mountains. In Chenggong Township there's a tiny church, cute like a Christmas card, and many people come specially to take photos. In Donghe Township there's a very pretty bus stop, and many people come specially to wait for the bus there. By the sea in Taitung City there's a little hut an artist made from wood, and it looks beautiful together with the sea. These places are so beautiful they look like scenes from animation.

levels.text: 台東喺台灣東部，係海岸山脈同太平洋之間，所以有好多天然靚景。成功鎮北邊有個宜灣部落，入面有間「卡片教堂」，外牆同裡面都有好多圖案同顏色，得意到好似聖誕卡片上面印嘅教堂咁。東河鎮就有個「知路橋公車站」，有人話係台東最靚嘅等車亭，用石牆同舊木整成，後面仲有棵好大嘅老樹。台東市嘅加路蘭海岸都好靚，有藝術家用漂流木整咗個小屋，同大海一齊睇好夢幻。
levels.text_en: Taitung is in eastern Taiwan, between the Coastal Mountain Range and the Pacific Ocean, so it has many natural beauty spots. North of Chenggong Township is the Yiwan tribal village, which has a 'Card Church.' Both its outer walls and interior have many patterns and colors, so cute it looks like a church printed on a Christmas card. Donghe Township has the 'Zhilu Bridge Bus Stop,' which some call the prettiest bus shelter in Taitung; it's made of stone walls and old wood, and behind it stands a very big old tree. The Jialulan Coast in Taitung City is also beautiful — an artist made a little hut out of driftwood, and seen together with the sea it looks dreamlike.

levels.text: 台東位於台灣東部，介於海岸山脈與太平洋之間，因此造就咗好多不可思議嘅天然美景。成功鎮北邊有個遺世獨立嘅宜灣部落，裡面藏住一間「卡片教堂」，原本係樸素嘅木屋，1974年畀颱風毀咗，之後由建築師賴明德重建，走歐洲鄉村風，外牆同內部都有活潑嘅圖案同色彩，可愛到吸引好多導演嚟取景。東河鎮嘅「知路橋公車站」，被網友譽為台東最美嘅候車亭，用天然石牆同廢棄木料打造，背後仲有棵巨大嘅老檜木。附近隆昌部落係阿美族製陶聚落，有間「我在玩-玩冰箱」早午餐店，用天然木板擺盤料理，展現海岸小農食材嘅多樣性。台東市嘅加路蘭海岸，原本係廢棄土置場，如今變成自然遊憩區，藝術家伊祐‧噶照用漂流木整咗個繭形小屋，同大海呼應，好似夢幻嘅風景。
levels.text_en: Taitung is in eastern Taiwan, between the Coastal Mountain Range and the Pacific Ocean, which has created many incredible natural beauty spots. North of Chenggong Township is the secluded Yiwan tribal village, which hides a 'Card Church.' It was originally a plain wooden house, destroyed by a typhoon in 1974, then rebuilt by architect Lai Ming-de in a European rural style; both outer walls and interior have lively patterns and colors, so cute it has attracted many directors to film there. Donghe Township's 'Zhilu Bridge Bus Stop' is praised by netizens as the most beautiful bus shelter in Taitung, built with natural stone walls and discarded wood, and behind it stands a giant old cypress tree. The nearby Longchang tribal village is an Amis pottery-making settlement, with a brunch shop called 'I'm Playing - Playing Fridge' that plates dishes on natural wooden boards, showing the diversity of coastal small-farm ingredients. Taitung City's Jialulan Coast was originally an abandoned dumping ground, now turned into a nature recreation area, where artist Iyo Kacaw made a cocoon-shaped hut from driftwood that echoes the sea, like a dreamlike scene.

levels.text: 台東在台灣東部。它夾在海岸山脈和太平洋之間，有很多美麗的天然景色。成功鎮的宜灣部落有一間「卡片教堂」。它本來是普通木屋，颱風吹毀後由賴明德重建，外形像聖誕卡片，很可愛。東河鎮有一個「知路橋公車站」，被稱為台東最美的候車亭，用石牆和舊木造成。附近的隆昌部落有一間早午餐店，叫「我在玩-玩冰箱」，用木板盛載食物，很有特色。台東市的加路蘭海岸原本是廢地，現在變成遊憩區。藝術家伊祐‧噶照用漂流木造了一間小屋，和大海很配。這些地方都美得像動畫世界。
levels.text_en: Taitung is in eastern Taiwan. Sandwiched between the Coastal Mountain Range and the Pacific Ocean, it has many beautiful natural scenes. The Yiwan tribal village in Chenggong Township has a 'Card Church.' It was originally an ordinary wooden house; after a typhoon destroyed it, Lai Ming-de rebuilt it, and its shape is like a Christmas card, very cute. Donghe Township has a 'Zhilu Bridge Bus Stop,' called the most beautiful bus shelter in Taitung, made of stone walls and old wood. The nearby Longchang tribal village has a brunch shop called 'I'm Playing - Playing Fridge,' which serves food on wooden boards, very distinctive. Taitung City's Jialulan Coast was originally wasteland and is now a recreation area. Artist Iyo Kacaw made a little hut from driftwood, which suits the sea well. These places are all beautiful like an animation world.

levels.text: 1. 成功鎮：宜灣卡片教堂 介於海岸山脈與太平洋之間的台東，造就了許多不可思議的天然美景，在大自然相伴之下來首先抵達台東成功鎮。在小鎮北邊有個遺世獨立的「宜灣部落」，部落裡藏着一座超級逗趣的小教堂，名字就叫「卡片教堂」。卡片教堂本名叫宜灣長老教會，原本是樸素普通的木造屋，但因為老建築在1974年毀於颱風，之後在賴明德建築師的手下重建。走歐洲鄉村風的卡片教堂，從外牆到內部有着活潑圖騰與色彩點綴，就像復古聖誕卡片上印的Q版教堂，可愛到令人想撲上去，也吸引許多導演前來取景！ 2. 東河鎮：知路橋公車站 「希望時間暫停在這一刻，充滿魔法的地方。」在網路上有着如此評語的知路橋公車站，位在舊台11線的知路橋站旁，為台東擁有「最美的候車亭」之稱的公車站牌，是前往東河鄉買肉包時，必定要駐足的當地名景。 知路橋原本只是不起眼的公車招呼站，一支招牌用輪胎灌漿水泥插着而已，但在兩年多前由「無心巖」創辦人租下旁邊土地作為友善農作分享平台，才順便整理出供人免費使用的候車亭。利用天然石牆以及廢棄木料打造候車亭，背後倚着的駁坎小坵生長着巨大的老檜木，幾乎被自然包覆的場景，更顯出人類的渺小。 儘管無心巖已經退場，但留下空間遺跡仍舊迷人，吸引許多人遠道前來等公車，在霧色迷離的清晨與向晚時分，總是懷抱一絲希望，搞不好可以偶遇龍貓呢！ 3. 東河鎮：我在玩-玩冰箱 轉進阿美族傳統製陶聚落的隆昌部落，在這裡有間被網友譽為「全台最美路邊攤」的小店，用茅草屋頂、漂流木、熱帶植物構築的街角空間，不拘小節的自然風情，簡直「鬆」到不行！ 店名口語而隨性的「我在玩-玩冰箱」，是當地人才知的隱藏版早午餐店，同時也結合木工體驗以及在地小農產品，每日極限量供應的餐點，若沒有事先預約，根本沒機會吃到。我在玩-玩冰箱以「豐盛玩美」為概念，最令人驚豔的就是用天然木板集合擺盤料理的多人共享早午餐，那粗獷卻繽紛有如花藝創作的呈現手法，展現出台東海岸部落小農食材的多樣性，同時也呼應了追求天然原味的飲食概念，以及追求無拘無束的自由生活態度。 4. 台東市：加路蘭海岸 遺世獨立的加路蘭海岸，是距離台東市區不太遠，開車往北走僅需15分鐘左右，渡過卑南溪之後，就能抵達的靜好海岸。 加路蘭海岸位在小野柳風景區附近，這裡原本是廢棄土置場，為空軍建設志航基地機場所用，如今在東海岸國家風景區管理處的整頓下，結合藝術與生態工法打造為自然遊憩區。 沿着海岸散策，可見藝術家創作裝置，例如「類窗櫺」、「日昇之舞」、「風車組」、「哭泣的露珠」等，最深受吸引的，莫過於原住民藝術家伊祐‧噶照（Iyo Kacaw）用漂流木做出繭型小屋，這個取名叫「在海邊看書，好嗎? 」的小屋，與大海形呼應形成奇幻的風景，簡直就像小煤炭精靈的巢！ 5. 台東市：Cheela小屋咖啡館 夜裡，Cheela小屋點燃微渺燈火，光滲透過重重植物的包圍，像神秘的龍貓樹洞，指引着人們往深
levels.text_en: 1. Chenggong Township: Yiwan Card Church. Taitung, lying between the Coastal Mountain Range and the Pacific Ocean, has created many incredible natural beauty spots. Accompanied by nature, we first arrive at Chenggong Township in Taitung. North of the town is the secluded 'Yiwan tribal village,' which hides a super amusing little church simply called the 'Card Church.' Its real name is Yiwan Presbyterian Church; it was originally a plain, ordinary wooden building, but the old structure was destroyed by a typhoon in 1974, then rebuilt by architect Lai Ming-de. The Card Church, in European rural style, has lively totems and colorful decorations from its outer walls to its interior, just like a chibi church printed on a retro Christmas card — so cute you want to pounce on it, and it has attracted many directors to film there! 2. Donghe Township: Zhilu Bridge Bus Stop. 'A magical place where you wish time would freeze at this moment.' With such reviews online, the Zhilu Bridge Bus Stop is beside the Zhilu Bridge station on the old Provincial Highway 11, the bus stop dubbed Taitung's 'most beautiful bus shelter,' a local scenic spot you must stop at when going to Donghe to buy pork buns. Zhilu Bridge was originally just an inconspicuous bus flag stop — one signboard stuck in with a tire filled with cement. But over two years ago, the founder of 'Wuxinyan' rented the land beside it as a friendly-farming sharing platform, and in the process tidied up a bus shelter for free public use. The shelter was built with natural stone walls and discarded wood; behind it, on a retaining-wall hillock, grows a giant old cypress tree, and the scene almost enveloped by nature makes humans seem tiny. Though Wuxinyan has since left, the remaining space and traces are still charming, drawing many people from afar to wait for the bus; in the misty early mornings and dusk, they always hold a sliver of hope that maybe they might run into Totoro! 3. Donghe Township: I'm Playing - Playing Fridge. Turning into Longchang tribal village, an Amis traditional pottery settlement, there's a small shop hailed by netizens as 'the most beautiful roadside stall in Taiwan,' a corner space built with a thatched roof, driftwood, and tropical plants — an unfussy natural vibe, utterly 'chill'! The colloquial and casual name 'I'm Playing - Playing Fridge' is a hidden brunch spot only locals know about, also combining woodworking experiences and local small-farm products; with an extremely limited daily supply, without a reservation there's basically no chance to eat there. Based on the concept of 'abundant, playful beauty,' its most stunning offering is the multi-person shared brunch plated together on natural wooden boards — a rough yet colorful presentation like floral art, showing the diversity of small-farm ingredients from Taitung's coastal tribes, echoing a diet that pursues natural original flavors and a free, unrestrained attitude to life. 4. Taitung City: Jialulan Coast. The secluded Jialulan Coast is not far from Taitung's downtown — about 15 minutes' drive north, and after crossing the Beinan River you reach this peaceful coast. Jialulan Coast is near the Xiaoyeliu Scenic Area; it was originally an abandoned dumping ground used for the Air Force's construction of Zhihang Base airport, and now, under the East Coast National Scenic Area Administration's renovation, it combines art and ecological engineering into a nature recreation area. Strolling along the coast, you can see artists' installations, such as 'Quasi Window Lattice,' 'Dance of the Rising Sun,' 'Windmill Set,' and 'Crying Dewdrop.' The most attractive of all is the cocoon-shaped hut made from driftwood by indigenous artist Iyo Kacaw; this hut, named 'Reading Books by the Sea, Shall We?', echoes the sea and forms a fantastical scene, just like a nest of the little soot sprites! 5. Taitung City: Cheela Hut Café. At night, Cheela Hut lights a faint glow; the light seeps through layers of surrounding plants, like a mysterious Totoro tree hollow, guiding people deeper in.

articles.summary_en: A travel feature about scenic spots in Taitung, on Taiwan's east coast between the Coastal Mountain Range and the Pacific Ocean, comparing them to the beautiful worlds of Studio Ghibli (Miyazaki) animation.

levels.text: 下個月會有第十一屆「一帶一路高峰論壇」，係特區政府同香港貿易發展局一齊搞嘅，會傾下「一帶一路」帶嚟嘅大生意機會。商務及經濟發展局局長丘應樺話，論壇會有中亞專場，佢仲想吸引外國嘅錢嚟北都發展。
levels.text_en: Next month there will be the 11th 'Belt and Road Summit,' organized jointly by the SAR government and the Hong Kong Trade Development Council. It will discuss the big business opportunities brought by the 'Belt and Road.' Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau said the forum will have a Central Asia session, and he also wants to attract foreign money to develop the North Metropolis.

articles.title: 【專訪劉香成．上】紀實攝影人眼中的世界：蘇聯解體與中國崛起
articles.summary: 呢篇訪問講攝影師劉香成用相機記錄咗新中國同世界大事嘅故事。

levels.text: 劉香成係一個影相記者。佢1951年喺香港出世，細個喺福州讀書。1978年佢做《時代》雜誌記者，返去中國影相。佢影咗好多普通人嘅生活，好似細路仔玩、街上嘅情侶噉。佢話中國人嘅日子好苦，但佢都想影低呢啲故事。後來佢仲去咗北京天安門同好多地方影相，成為好出名嘅影相人。
levels.text_en: Liu Heung Shing is a photojournalist. He was born in Hong Kong in 1951 and studied in Fuzhou as a child. In 1978 he became a reporter for Time magazine and went back to China to take photos. He photographed many ordinary people's lives, like children playing and couples on the street. He said the Chinese people's lives were very hard, but he still wanted to capture these stories. Later he also went to Beijing's Tiananmen and many other places to take photos, becoming a very famous photographer.

levels.text: 劉香成係一個好出名嘅影相記者。佢1951年喺香港出世，十歲之前喺福州讀書，爸爸做過《大公報》編輯。佢長大之後去美國讀書，跟住學識影相，做咗《時代》同美聯社嘅首席影相記者。1978年佢派去中國，係頭八個派駐北京嘅美國記者之一。佢影低好多當年中國普通人嘅日常，好似細路仔舉起拳頭、市民睇大字報、農民收白菜、青年喺毛澤東像前面玩。佢話呢啲眾生相就係最有詩意嘅時代見證。後來佢仲去北京天安門同好多地方影相，成為新聞界好有名嘅人。
levels.text_en: Liu Heung Shing is a very famous photojournalist. He was born in Hong Kong in 1951, studied in Fuzhou before the age of ten, and his father had been an editor at Ta Kung Pao. When he grew up he went to study in the US, then learned photography and became the chief photojournalist for Time and the Associated Press. In 1978 he was sent to China, one of the first eight American journalists posted to Beijing. He captured the daily lives of ordinary Chinese people back then, like children raising their fists, citizens reading big-character posters, farmers harvesting cabbages, and youths playing in front of a Mao Zedong statue. He said these portraits of ordinary people are the most poetic witness of the era. Later he also photographed Beijing's Tiananmen and many other places, becoming a well-known figure in journalism.

levels.text: 劉香成係一位著名嘅紀實攝影記者。美國前總統尼克遜1972年訪華之後，美國媒體開始對中國好有興趣。劉香成1978年做《時代》雜誌記者派駐中國，係首八位派駐北京嘅美國記者之一。當時Fox Butterfield出版咗一本關於中國嘅書《苦海餘生》，入面啲相都係劉香成嘅作品。佢新書叫《紅海餘生》，正正呼應三十七年前嗰本書。劉香成1951年喺香港出世，爸爸做過《大公報》編輯，佢因為家庭出身，喺班上係唯一冇戴紅領巾嘅。長大後佢去美國讀國際關係，之後學識攝影，做咗《時代》同美聯社嘅首席攝影記者。佢記錄咗當年中國庶民嘅日常，仲見證咗天安門、韓國民運、蘇聯阿富汗戰爭等大事。
levels.text_en: Liu Heung Shing is a renowned documentary photojournalist. After former US President Nixon visited China in 1972, American media began to take great interest in China. Liu Heung Shing became a Time magazine reporter posted to China in 1978, one of the first eight American journalists posted to Beijing. At the time Fox Butterfield published a book about China called 'China: Alive in the Bitter Sea', and the photos in it were Liu Heung Shing's work. His new book is called 'A Life in a Sea of Red', echoing that book from thirty-seven years ago. Liu Heung Shing was born in Hong Kong in 1951, his father had been an editor at Ta Kung Pao, and because of his family background he was the only one in his class who did not wear a red scarf. When he grew up he went to the US to study international relations, then learned photography and became the chief photojournalist for Time and the Associated Press. He documented the daily lives of ordinary Chinese people back then, and also witnessed major events like Tiananmen, the Korean democracy movement, and the Soviet-Afghan war.

levels.text: 劉香成是一位著名的攝影記者。1972年，美國前總統尼克遜訪華，令美國媒體開始關注中國。劉香成在1978年做《時代》雜誌記者，被派到中國，是首八位派駐北京的美國記者之一。當時有記者出版了一本關於中國的書《苦海餘生》，書中的照片都是他拍攝的。他的新書《紅海餘生》，正好呼應那本書。劉香成1951年在香港出生，父親曾任《大公報》編輯。他因為家庭出身，小時候是全班唯一沒戴紅領巾的學生。長大後他到美國讀書，後來學會攝影，做了《時代》和美聯社的首席攝影記者。他記錄了當年中國普通人的生活，也見證了天安門、韓國民運和蘇聯阿富汗戰爭等大事。
levels.text_en: Liu Heung Shing is a renowned photojournalist. In 1972, former US President Nixon visited China, causing American media to begin paying attention to China. Liu Heung Shing became a Time magazine reporter in 1978 and was sent to China, one of the first eight American journalists posted to Beijing. At the time a journalist published a book about China called 'China: Alive in the Bitter Sea', and the photos in the book were all taken by him. His new book 'A Life in a Sea of Red' echoes that book. Liu Heung Shing was born in Hong Kong in 1951, his father had served as an editor at Ta Kung Pao. Because of his family background, as a child he was the only student in his whole class who did not wear a red scarf. When he grew up he went to study in the US, later learned photography, and became the chief photojournalist for Time and the Associated Press. He documented the lives of ordinary Chinese people back then, and also witnessed major events like Tiananmen, the Korean democracy movement, and the Soviet-Afghan war.

levels.text: 一. 苦海過後的新中國 美國已故總統尼克遜（Richard Nixon）於1972年訪華後，美國媒體開始對中國產生較大的興趣。那時，美國三大報刊記者Fox Butterfield（《紐約時報》）、Richard Bernstein（《時代》雜誌）、Jay Mathews（《華盛頓郵報》）爭先出版一部關於中國的書，劉香成在1978年作為《時代》雜誌記者派駐中國，是首八位派駐北京的美國記者之一。翌年，中美便正式建交了。 最終Fox Butterfield搶先出版了，書名為《苦海餘生》（China：Alive in the Bitter Sea，1982），書中照片都是劉香成的作品。「這本書在那個時代是比較深刻的報道，可以說是很有分量、關於新中國的報道。」劉香成的新書書名叫做 《A Life in a Sea of Red》 （中文暫譯作《紅海餘生》），正是呼應該部三十七年前的作品。 「苦海餘生是中國道家思想，形容人類要過這一生所面對的是苦海，社會狀況多多少少都是很苦的。在這麼苦的人生裏面，你怎樣找到平衡，找到自己生活的理念。所以，苦海餘生是形容中國人很深刻的生活體驗。」這種苦，也許年幼時的劉香成也嘗過一點：1951年出生於香港，十歲前在福州念書，父親是知識分子，曾任《大公報》編輯，母親則是清官後代、大地主，因此，劉香成作為「黑五類」後代，是班中幾十名同學之中，唯一沒帶上紅領巾的。 正因在內地度過童年，使劉香成對中國、對政治有了興趣，長大後就到美國念國際關係，因選修《Life》雜誌攝影師Gjon Mili的攝影課，輾轉做了他的實習生，展開了自己的專業生涯，先後擔任《時代》及美聯社的首席攝影記者。 毛澤東去世之後，也是劉香成回到中國的時機，雖然趕不及回去採訪毛澤東的葬禮，卻剛好見證一個新時代之始。「在大陸，我從第一天就知道這是人類一個很大的故事，如果這個故事那麼大，而我又做紀實攝影的，你不去為這故事投資時間、精力，那還有什麼可做？」 1983年，劉香成首度把攝於1976至1982年的照片輯錄成書：孩子高舉拳頭批鬥四人幫、七十年代末北京市民圍看「西單民主牆」大字報、北京農民收割大白菜、大連青年在毛澤東像前玩滑輪，年輕情侶在街上依偎，或是穿着列寧裝卻拿着「可口可樂」的青年。 記錄的都是那些年中國庶民的日常，畫面雖然沒他採訪八九民運、韓國民運、蘇聯阿富汗戰爭那麼動魄驚心，也沒政治巨人那麼具標誌性，但眾生相往往是最富詩意的時代見證。這書在1983年初次出版，但至2010年左右才於內地面世。「當時很有趣，大陸不敢稱此書為《毛之後的中國》，在大陸，什麼是political correctness（政治正確）很重要，你叫毛澤東之後的中國，很disrespectful（不尊重）。」 二. 從天安門跑到克里姆林宮 1989年在北京天安門廣場的報道是劉香成的「成名作」之一，獲得新聞界廣
levels.text_en: 1. The New China After the Bitter Sea. After the late US President Richard Nixon visited China in 1972, American media began to take greater interest in China. At that time, journalists from the three major American papers—Fox Butterfield (The New York Times), Richard Bernstein (Time magazine), and Jay Mathews (The Washington Post)—raced to publish a book about China. Liu Heung Shing was posted to China as a Time magazine reporter in 1978, one of the first eight American journalists posted to Beijing. The following year, China and the US formally established diplomatic relations. In the end Fox Butterfield published first, with the book titled 'China: Alive in the Bitter Sea' (1982), and the photos in the book were all Liu Heung Shing's work. 'This book was a fairly profound piece of reporting for its time, you could say it was a very weighty report about the new China.' Liu Heung Shing's new book is titled 'A Life in a Sea of Red' (tentatively translated into Chinese as Hong Hai Yu Sheng), precisely echoing that work from thirty-seven years ago. 'Bitter sea is a Chinese Taoist idea, describing that what humans face in living out this life is a sea of bitterness; social conditions are more or less very bitter. Within such a bitter life, how do you find balance, find your own philosophy of living? So the bitter sea describes the very profound life experience of the Chinese people.' Perhaps young Liu Heung Shing tasted a bit of this bitterness too: born in Hong Kong in 1951, he studied in Fuzhou before the age of ten. His father was an intellectual who had served as an editor at Ta Kung Pao, and his mother was a descendant of an honest official and a big landlord. Thus, as a descendant of the 'five black categories', Liu Heung Shing was the only one among the several dozen classmates who did not wear a red scarf. It was precisely because he spent his childhood on the mainland that Liu Heung Shing developed an interest in China and in politics; when he grew up he went to the US to study international relations, and because he took a photography course by Life magazine photographer Gjon Mili, he eventually became his intern, launching his professional career, successively serving as chief photojournalist for Time and the Associated Press. After Mao Zedong's death was also the moment Liu Heung Shing returned to China; although he did not make it back in time to cover Mao's funeral, he happened to witness the beginning of a new era. 'On the mainland, from the very first day I knew this was a huge human story, and if the story is that big, and I'm a documentary photographer, if you don't invest time and energy in this story, then what else is there to do?' In 1983, Liu Heung Shing first compiled his photos taken from 1976 to 1982 into a book: children raising their fists to denounce the Gang of Four, Beijing citizens gathered to read big-character posters at the 'Xidan Democracy Wall' in the late 1970s, Beijing farmers harvesting cabbages, Dalian youths roller-skating in front of a Mao Zedong statue, young couples snuggling on the street, or youths dressed in Lenin suits holding 'Coca-Cola'. What he recorded was all the daily life of ordinary Chinese people in those years. Although the images are not as heart-stopping as his coverage of the 1989 democracy movement, the Korean democracy movement, or the Soviet-Afghan war, and not as iconic as political giants, the portraits of ordinary people are often the most poetic witness of an era. This book was first published in 1983, but it did not appear on the mainland until around 2010. 'It was very interesting at the time; the mainland did not dare call the book "China After Mao". On the mainland, what is political correctness matters a lot—calling it China after Mao Zedong was very disrespectful.' 2. From Tiananmen to the Kremlin. His 1989 reporting at Beijing's Tiananmen Square is one of Liu Heung Shing's 'signature works', winning journalism...

articles.title: 香港快運調整今日和明天航班安排　高鐵今日至下周一多班車次取消
articles.summary: 因為颱風白海豚，香港快運同高鐵都取消咗一啲航班同車次。

levels.text: 因為颱風白海豚嚟到，香港快運話今日同聽日都要改航班安排。今日、聽日來往香港同寧波嘅兩班機取消咗。今日去日本嗰邊都有四班機唔飛。高鐵方面，由今日到下星期一，有八班車都取消，唔行香港去上海同廣州。
levels.text_en: Because Typhoon Baihaidun is arriving, HK Express says it has to change its flight arrangements today and tomorrow. The two flights between Hong Kong and Ningbo today and tomorrow are cancelled. Four flights to Japan today are also not flying. For the high-speed rail, from today to next Monday, eight trains are cancelled and won't run from Hong Kong to Shanghai and Guangzhou.

levels.text: 受颱風白海豚影響，香港快運話已經調整咗今日同聽日嘅航班安排。今明兩日來往香港同寧波嘅兩班機UO226同UO227取消咗，聽日由香港飛去寧波嗰班UO226改為星期一朝早先起飛。至於今日來往本港同日本沖繩、石垣嘅航班，一共有四班機取消。鐵路方面，港鐵話因為天氣惡劣，由今日到下星期一，一共有八班高鐵取消，涉及香港西九龍站來往上海同廣州。
levels.text_en: Affected by Typhoon Baihaidun, HK Express says it has already adjusted its flight arrangements for today and tomorrow. The two flights UO226 and UO227 between Hong Kong and Ningbo for today and tomorrow are cancelled; tomorrow's UO226 from Hong Kong to Ningbo is changed to depart on Monday morning instead. As for today's flights between Hong Kong and Japan's Okinawa and Ishigaki, a total of four flights are cancelled. On the rail side, the MTR says that due to bad weather, from today to next Monday a total of eight high-speed trains are cancelled, involving service between Hong Kong West Kowloon Station and Shanghai and Guangzhou.
