articles.title: 拜仁慕尼黑2：1擊敗阿士東維拉　逾3.8萬人啟德主場館觀賽
articles.summary: 喺啟德主場館，拜仁慕尼黑踢2：1贏咗阿士東維拉，超過3.8萬人入場睇波。

levels.text: 琴晚喺啟德主場館，德國隊拜仁慕尼黑踢2：1贏咗英國隊阿士東維拉，超過3.8萬人入場睇波。上半場拜仁先入一球，領先1：0。落到下半場，兩隊都換咗好多人，拜仁再入多一球，變成2：0。維拉之後追返一球，最後拜仁贏一球完場。
levels.text_en: Last night at Kai Tak Stadium, German team Bayern Munich beat English team Aston Villa 2-1, with over 38,000 people coming to watch. In the first half Bayern scored first, leading 1-0. In the second half both teams made many substitutions, and Bayern scored another goal, making it 2-0. Villa then pulled one back, and in the end Bayern won by one goal at full time.

levels.text: 琴晚喺啟德主場館，上演咗一場季前熱身賽，德甲拜仁慕尼黑踢2：1贏咗英超阿士東維拉，賽事吸引超過3.8萬人入場睇波。上半場37分鐘，比索夫用左腳開罰球，金玟哉頂頭鎚入波，拜仁半場領先1：0。下半場兩隊都換咗好多人，後備上場嘅路爾斯迪亞斯喺73分鐘射入，拜仁擴大比數。維拉之後全力反攻，祖奧高美斯喺83分鐘射入，追到1：2。之後艾巴咸有機會頂頭鎚，但畀拜仁門將紐亞撲走，最後拜仁維持一球優勢贏波。
levels.text_en: Last night at Kai Tak Stadium, a pre-season warm-up match was staged, in which German Bundesliga side Bayern Munich beat English Premier League side Aston Villa 2-1, with the match drawing over 38,000 people to watch. In the 37th minute of the first half, Bisseck took a free kick with his left foot and Kim Min-jae headed it in, giving Bayern a 1-0 lead at the break. In the second half both teams made many substitutions, and substitute Luis Diaz scored in the 73rd minute to extend Bayern's lead. Villa then went all-out on the counter-attack, and Joao Gomes scored in the 83rd minute to close the gap to 1-2. Afterwards Elghamran (Abraham) had a chance to head one in, but it was saved by Bayern keeper Neuer, and in the end Bayern held on to their one-goal advantage to win.

levels.text: 琴晚喺啟德主場館，上演咗一場足球峰會季前熱身賽。德甲拜仁慕尼黑以2：1擊敗英超阿士東維拉，賽事吸引超過3.8萬人入場觀賽。上半場37分鐘，比索夫用左腳開出罰球，金玟哉頂頭鎚入波，拜仁半場領先1：0。兩隊喺下半場分別作出多個換人調動，後備上場嘅路爾斯迪亞斯喺禁區左路射遠柱，皮球擦楣底入網，喺73分鐘為拜仁擴大比數。落後兩球嘅維拉全力反撲，祖奧高美斯喺83分鐘喺禁區頂遠射入網，為維拉追至1：2嘅接近比數。艾巴咸之後有頭鎚攻門機會，但畀拜仁門將紐亞撲走。最後拜仁維持一球優勢完場，勝出賽事。
levels.text_en: Last night at Kai Tak Stadium, a Football Festival pre-season warm-up match was staged. German Bundesliga side Bayern Munich beat English Premier League side Aston Villa 2-1, with the match drawing over 38,000 people to watch. In the 37th minute of the first half, Bisseck took a free kick with his left foot and Kim Min-jae headed it in, giving Bayern a 1-0 lead at the break. Both teams made several substitutions in the second half, and substitute Luis Diaz, from the left of the box, shot at the far post, the ball grazing the underside of the crossbar into the net, extending Bayern's lead in the 73rd minute. Two goals down, Villa counter-attacked with all their might, and Joao Gomes scored from a header in the box (long-range shot) in the 83rd minute, pulling Villa back to a close 1-2. Abraham later had a heading chance on goal, but it was saved by Bayern keeper Neuer. In the end Bayern held on to their one-goal advantage at full time to win the match.

levels.text: 昨晚在啟德主場館，舉行了一場季前熱身賽。德甲球隊拜仁慕尼黑以2：1擊敗英超球隊阿士東維拉，吸引超過3.8萬人入場觀看。上半場37分鐘，比索夫開出罰球，金玟哉頂頭鎚入球，拜仁以1：0領先。下半場兩隊都換了不少人。後備上場的路爾斯迪亞斯在73分鐘再入一球，令拜仁領先2：0。維拉全力反攻，祖奧高美斯在83分鐘入球，追到1：2。之後艾巴咸有機會頂頭鎚，但被拜仁門將紐亞撲走。最後拜仁保持一球優勢，贏得比賽。
levels.text_en: Last night at Kai Tak Stadium, a pre-season warm-up match was held. German Bundesliga club Bayern Munich beat English Premier League club Aston Villa 2-1, drawing over 38,000 people to watch. In the 37th minute of the first half, Bisseck took a free kick and Kim Min-jae headed it in, giving Bayern a 1-0 lead. In the second half both teams made quite a few substitutions. Substitute Luis Diaz scored again in the 73rd minute, giving Bayern a 2-0 lead. Villa counter-attacked with all their might, and Joao Gomes scored in the 83rd minute to close to 1-2. Afterwards Abraham had a chance to head one in, but it was saved by Bayern keeper Neuer. In the end Bayern kept their one-goal advantage and won the match.

levels.text: 晚上在啟德主場館上演的足球峰會季前熱身賽，德甲拜仁慕尼黑2：1擊敗英超阿士東維拉，賽事吸引超過3.8萬人入場。 上半場37分鐘，比索夫左腳開出罰球，金玟哉頭鎚頂入，拜仁半場領先1：0。 兩隊在下半場分別作出多個換人調動，後備入替的路爾斯迪亞斯禁區左路射遠柱，皮球擦楣底入網，為拜仁在73分鐘擴大比數。 落後兩球的維拉全力反撲，祖奧高美斯83分鐘在禁區頂遠射入網，為維拉追至1：2的接近比數。艾巴咸及後有頭鎚攻門機會，但被拜仁門將紐亞撲走。 最終拜仁維持一球優勢完場，勝出賽事。
levels.text_en: In the Football Festival pre-season warm-up match staged in the evening at Kai Tak Stadium, German Bundesliga side Bayern Munich beat English Premier League side Aston Villa 2-1, with the match drawing over 38,000 people to attend. In the 37th minute of the first half, Bisseck took a free kick with his left foot and Kim Min-jae headed it in, giving Bayern a 1-0 lead at the break. Both teams made several substitutions in the second half, and substitute Luis Diaz shot at the far post from the left of the box, the ball grazing the underside of the crossbar into the net, extending Bayern's lead in the 73rd minute. Two goals down, Villa counter-attacked with all their might, and Joao Gomes scored from a long-range shot in the box in the 83rd minute, pulling Villa back to a close 1-2. Abraham later had a heading chance on goal, but it was saved by Bayern keeper Neuer. In the end Bayern held on to their one-goal advantage at full time to win the match.

articles.summary_en: A pre-season football friendly played at Hong Kong's Kai Tak Stadium, where German club Bayern Munich beat English club Aston Villa 2-1 in front of over 38,000 spectators.

articles.title: 李家超鼓勵保險業界開發跨境養老和醫療保險產品　便利灣區居民
articles.summary: 李家超叫保險公司開發跨境養老同醫療保險，方便灣區居民。

levels.text: 行政長官李家超出席保險界活動時話，鼓勵各公司開發跨境養老同醫療保險，方便灣區居民。政府會繼續同內地部門傾，令有香港保單嘅人得到更好嘅售後支援，等兩地保險市場可以互通。佢仲想香港善用科技，做好風險管理。
levels.text_en: At an insurance industry event, Chief Executive John Lee said he encourages companies to develop cross-border retirement and medical insurance to benefit Greater Bay Area residents. The government will keep talking with mainland departments so that people holding Hong Kong policies get better after-sales support, letting the two places' insurance markets connect. He also wants Hong Kong to make good use of technology and do risk management well.

levels.text: 行政長官李家超出席一個保險界活動致辭時話，鼓勵業界開發跨境養老同醫療保險產品，方便灣區居民。政府會繼續同內地部門密切溝通，為持有香港保單嘅居民提供更好嘅售後支援，令兩地保險市場互通。佢又話已經促成七宗巨災債券發行，總額約六十二億港元，支持內地同環球市場管理風險。佢仲想爭取更多海內外企業喺香港成立自保保險公司，同推動業界善用人工智能同保險科技。
levels.text_en: Giving a speech at an insurance industry event, Chief Executive John Lee said he encourages the sector to develop cross-border retirement and medical insurance products to benefit Greater Bay Area residents. The government will keep in close communication with mainland departments to provide better after-sales support for residents holding Hong Kong policies, connecting the two places' insurance markets. He also said the government has facilitated the issuance of seven catastrophe bonds, totaling about HK$6.2 billion, supporting risk management in the mainland and global markets. He also wants to attract more domestic and overseas enterprises to set up self-insurance (captive) companies in Hong Kong, and to push the sector to make good use of artificial intelligence and insurance technology.

levels.text: 行政長官李家超出席一項保險業界活動致辭時話，鼓勵業界開發跨境養老同醫療保險產品，方便灣區居民。政府會繼續同內地部門密切溝通，為持有香港保單嘅居民提供更完善嘅售後支援，促進兩地保險市場互聯互通。佢話，政府為保險相連證券設立專屬規管制度，並推出資助計劃，至今已促成七宗巨災債券發行，總額約六十二億港元，支持內地同環球市場管理風險。佢又提到業界善用香港作為國際航運中心嘅優勢，成立獨立嘅航運專項風險池，至今已有超過八百艘船隻受保。佢仲想爭取更多海內外企業喺香港成立自保保險公司，並推動業界善用人工智能同保險科技。
levels.text_en: Giving a speech at an insurance industry event, Chief Executive John Lee said he encourages the sector to develop cross-border retirement and medical insurance products to benefit Greater Bay Area residents. The government will keep in close communication with mainland departments to provide more comprehensive after-sales support for residents holding Hong Kong policies, promoting interconnection of the two places' insurance markets. He said the government has set up a dedicated regulatory regime for insurance-linked securities and launched a funding scheme, so far facilitating the issuance of seven catastrophe bonds totaling about HK$6.2 billion, supporting risk management in the mainland and global markets. He also mentioned that the sector has made good use of Hong Kong's advantage as an international shipping center, setting up an independent shipping-specific risk pool, with over 800 vessels now insured. He also wants to attract more domestic and overseas enterprises to set up captive insurance companies in Hong Kong, and to push the sector to make good use of artificial intelligence and insurance technology.

levels.text: 行政長官李家超出席一個保險業界活動時致辭。他鼓勵業界開發跨境養老和醫療保險產品，方便大灣區居民。政府會繼續和內地部門溝通，為持有香港保單的居民提供更好的售後支援，令兩地保險市場互通。他說，政府設立了相關的規管制度，並推出資助計劃，至今已促成七宗巨災債券發行，總額約六十二億港元。業界也善用香港航運中心的優勢，成立航運風險池，至今已有超過八百艘船隻受保。他還希望爭取更多企業在香港成立自保保險公司，並推動業界善用人工智能和保險科技。
levels.text_en: Chief Executive John Lee gave a speech at an insurance industry event. He encouraged the sector to develop cross-border retirement and medical insurance products to benefit Greater Bay Area residents. The government will keep communicating with mainland departments to provide better after-sales support for residents holding Hong Kong policies, connecting the two places' insurance markets. He said the government has set up the relevant regulatory regime and launched a funding scheme, so far facilitating the issuance of seven catastrophe bonds totaling about HK$6.2 billion. The sector has also made good use of Hong Kong's shipping-center advantage, setting up a shipping risk pool, with over 800 vessels now insured. He also hopes to attract more enterprises to set up captive insurance companies in Hong Kong, and to push the sector to make good use of artificial intelligence and insurance technology.

levels.text: 行政長官李家超出席一項保險業界的活動致辭時表示，鼓勵業界開發跨境養老和醫療保險產品，便利灣區居民，政府會繼續與內地部門密切溝通，為持有香港保單的居民，提供更完善的售後支援，促進兩地保險市場互聯互通。 李家超表示，為保險相連證券設立專屬規管制度，並推出資助計劃，至今已促成7宗巨災債券發行，總額約62億港元，支持內地和環球市場管理風險。他又提到業界亦善用香港作為國際航運中心的優勢，成立獨立的航運專項風險池，為香港和內地船舶提供保障，至今已有超過800艘船隻受保。 他表示，將繼續爭取更多海內外企業在香港成立專屬的自保保險公司，並積極推動業界善用人工智能和保險科技，鼓勵負責任的創新，完善全球市場的風險管理策略。
levels.text_en: Giving a speech at an insurance industry event, Chief Executive John Lee said he encourages the sector to develop cross-border retirement and medical insurance products to benefit Greater Bay Area residents; the government will keep in close communication with mainland departments to provide more comprehensive after-sales support for residents holding Hong Kong policies, promoting interconnection of the two places' insurance markets. Lee said that, having set up a dedicated regulatory regime for insurance-linked securities and launched a funding scheme, so far seven catastrophe bonds have been issued, totaling about HK$6.2 billion, supporting risk management in the mainland and global markets. He also mentioned that the sector has made good use of Hong Kong's advantage as an international shipping center by setting up an independent shipping-specific risk pool to provide coverage for Hong Kong and mainland vessels, with over 800 vessels now insured. He said he will continue to attract more domestic and overseas enterprises to set up dedicated captive insurance companies in Hong Kong, and actively push the sector to make good use of artificial intelligence and insurance technology, encouraging responsible innovation and improving risk management strategies for the global market.

articles.summary_en: Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee spoke at an insurance industry event, encouraging the sector to develop cross-border retirement and medical insurance products for residents of the Greater Bay Area (the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau region).

articles.title: 社署籲市民避免回覆偽冒社署通訊應用程式帳戶
articles.summary: 社署話有人扮佢哋開咗個假嘅通訊程式帳戶，叫大家唔好回覆，亦唔好畀個人資料。

levels.text: 社署提醒大家小心，有人扮社署開咗個通訊程式帳戶，係假嘅。大家唔好回覆佢，亦唔好畀自己嘅個人資料佢。社署話同呢個帳戶冇任何關係，已經搵警方跟進。大家記住要提高警覺呀。
levels.text_en: The SWD reminds everyone to be careful: someone has opened a messaging-app account pretending to be the SWD—it's fake. Don't reply to it, and don't give it your personal information. The SWD says it has no connection with this account and has already asked the police to follow up. Everyone remember to stay alert.

levels.text: 社會福利署提醒市民要提高警覺，有人扮社署開咗個通訊程式帳戶，其實係假嘅。社署話呢個假帳戶訛稱代表社署服務中心，想呃市民回覆佢嘅短訊，或者撳短訊入面嗰啲唔知係咩嘅連結，噉樣就可以盜取市民嘅個人資料。社署強調同呢個帳戶冇任何關係，叫大家唔好回覆，亦唔好向佢提供個人資料，並且已經將件事交畀警方跟進。
levels.text_en: The Social Welfare Department reminds the public to stay alert: someone has opened a messaging-app account pretending to be the SWD, but it's actually fake. The SWD says this fake account falsely claims to represent an SWD service centre, trying to trick the public into replying to its messages or clicking unknown links inside the messages, so as to steal people's personal data. The SWD stresses it has no connection with this account, urges everyone not to reply and not to give it personal information, and has already handed the matter to the police to follow up.

levels.text: 社會福利署呼籲市民提高警覺，避免回覆偽冒社署嘅通訊應用程式帳戶，亦唔好向有關帳戶提供個人資料。社署表示，該程式帳戶訛稱代表社署服務中心，企圖誘騙市民回覆佢嘅短訊，或者撳短訊入面啲唔明嘅連結，藉此盜取市民嘅個人資料。署方強調，社署同該程式帳戶冇任何關係，並且已經將事件交畀警方跟進。市民如果收到呢類短訊，記住要小心處理，切勿隨便提供自己嘅資料。
levels.text_en: The Social Welfare Department calls on the public to stay alert, to avoid replying to a messaging-app account impersonating the SWD, and not to give that account personal information. The SWD says the account falsely claims to represent an SWD service centre, attempting to lure the public into replying to its messages or clicking unclear links inside the messages, thereby stealing people's personal data. The department stresses that the SWD has no connection with the account and has already handed the matter to the police to follow up. If members of the public receive this kind of message, remember to handle it carefully and never carelessly provide your own information.

levels.text: 社會福利署提醒市民提高警覺。近日有偽冒社署嘅通訊程式帳戶出現。市民應避免回覆，亦不要提供個人資料。社署表示，該帳戶訛稱代表社署服務中心。它試圖誘騙市民回覆短訊，或撳短訊內不明嘅連結，從而盜取個人資料。社署強調，與該帳戶並無任何關係，並已把事件交警方跟進。
levels.text_en: The Social Welfare Department reminds the public to stay alert. Recently a messaging-app account impersonating the SWD has appeared. The public should avoid replying and should not provide personal information. The SWD says the account falsely claims to represent an SWD service centre. It tries to lure the public into replying to messages or clicking unclear links within the messages, so as to steal personal data. The SWD stresses it has no connection with the account and has already handed the matter to the police to follow up.

levels.text: 社會福利署呼籲市民提高警覺，避免回覆偽冒社署的通訊應用程式帳戶，或向有關程式帳戶提供個人資料。 社署表示，該程式帳戶訛稱代表社署服務中心，企圖誘騙市民回覆其短訊或點擊短訊內的不明連結，以盗取市民的個人資料。 署方強調與該程式帳戶沒有任何關係，並已把事件交警方跟進。
levels.text_en: The Social Welfare Department calls on the public to stay alert, to avoid replying to a messaging-app account impersonating the SWD, or providing personal information to that account. The SWD says the account falsely claims to represent an SWD service centre, attempting to lure the public into replying to its messages or clicking unclear links within the messages, in order to steal people's personal data. The department stresses it has no connection with the account and has already handed the matter to the police to follow up.

articles.summary_en: The Social Welfare Department (SWD) in Hong Kong is warning the public about a fake messaging-app account impersonating the department, which is being used to steal personal data.

levels.text: 政府今日話俾大家知，2026年選委會界別分組選舉會喺11月22日投票，揀出新一屆嘅選委。提名期由10月7日開始，到10月20日就完。之後仲會公布交表嘅時間同地點。
levels.text_en: The government announced today that the 2026 Election Committee subsector election will be held on November 22, to choose the new term of Election Committee members. The nomination period starts on October 7 and ends on October 20. The time and place for submitting forms will be announced later.

levels.text: 政府今日刊憲，公布行政長官已經根據《行政長官選舉條例》嘅規定，指明2026年選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉喺11月22日投票，揀出新一屆選委會嘅選任委員。提名期由10月7日開始，到10月20日結束。總選舉事務主任會喺適當時候刊登公告，指明交提名表格嘅限期同地點，仲會公布相關細節。

articles.title: 特朗普簽署行政命令　對進口多晶硅徵收關稅
articles.summary: 美國總統特朗普簽咗命令，要對外國入口嘅多晶硅收關稅，中國就話好反對。

levels.text: 美國總統特朗普簽咗一份命令，要對外國運入嚟嘅多晶硅收關稅。多晶硅係用嚟做電腦晶片同太陽能板嘅，佢想美國少啲靠外國供應。稅率大約一成半，一百二十日之後先生效。中國就話好反對美國噉樣做。
levels.text_en: US President Trump signed an order to charge tariffs on polysilicon imported from abroad. Polysilicon is used to make computer chips and solar panels, and he wants the US to rely less on foreign supply. The tariff rate is about 15%, and it takes effect only after 120 days. China said it strongly opposes the US doing this.

levels.text: 美國總統特朗普簽咗一份行政命令，要對外國運入嚟嘅多晶硅收關稅。多晶硅係用嚟整半導體同太陽能板嘅，特朗普想美國少啲靠外國供應。白宮嘅顧問沙夫話，稅率預計係一成半，仲會有最低價格限制，措施一百二十日之後先生效。喺北京嗰邊，外交部發言人林劍就話，中方堅決反對美方噉樣無理打壓中國企業，會繼續維護中國企業嘅正當權益。
levels.text_en: US President Trump signed an executive order to charge tariffs on polysilicon imported from abroad. Polysilicon is used to make semiconductors and solar panels, and Trump wants the US to rely less on foreign supply. White House adviser Shaw said the tariff rate is expected to be 15%, and there will also be a minimum price limit; the measure takes effect only after 120 days. In Beijing, foreign ministry spokesman Lin Jian said China firmly opposes the US unreasonably suppressing Chinese enterprises like this, and will continue to protect the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese enterprises.

articles.title: 【馮睎乾十三維度】房屋局當然違反《公開資料守則》
articles.summary: 房屋局唔肯公開宏福苑驗樓報告，作者話佢其實違反咗《公開資料守則》。

levels.text: 火災之後，宏福苑啲居民好想睇驗樓報告，但係房屋局唔肯公開。房屋局話報告未做完，怕大家睇錯，所以唔畀報告出街。有記者向政府投訴，但係申訴署話房屋局冇做錯。作者就好唔同意，佢覺得房屋局係搵藉口，其實可以公開報告，只要加返啲解釋就得㗎喇。
levels.text_en: After the fire, residents of Wang Fuk Court really wanted to see the building inspection report, but the Housing Bureau refused to make it public. The Bureau said the report wasn't finished and worried people would misread it, so it wouldn't release it. A reporter complained to the government, but the Ombudsman said the Housing Bureau did nothing wrong. The author strongly disagrees. He thinks the Housing Bureau is making excuses—it actually could release the report, as long as it added some explanatory notes.

levels.text: 宏福苑火災之後，好多居民都想睇驗樓報告，但係房屋局一直唔肯公開。《明報》記者根據《公開資料守則》向房屋局要報告，等咗成個幾月，房屋局先話：因為就到雨季風季、樓宇結構要繼續監測、報告未做完可能令人誤解，所以拒絕公開。記者於是向申訴專員公署投訴，話收購宏福苑用咗公帑，關乎公眾利益。點知申訴署都話房屋局冇違反《守則》。作者好懷疑：房屋局究竟用邊條《守則》去封鎖報告呢？其實《守則》話明，就算資料未完成，只要加返啲解釋，部門一樣可以公開。所以房屋局根本係搵藉口。
levels.text_en: After the fire at Wang Fuk Court, many residents wanted to see the building inspection report, but the Housing Bureau kept refusing to make it public. A Ming Pao reporter requested the report from the Housing Bureau under the Code on Access to Information. After waiting more than a month, the Bureau finally said: because the rainy and typhoon season was coming, the building structure needed continued monitoring, and an unfinished report could mislead people, it refused to release it. The reporter then complained to the Office of the Ombudsman, saying the acquisition of Wang Fuk Court used public funds and concerned the public interest. But the Ombudsman also said the Housing Bureau did not violate the Code. The author is very skeptical: which clause of the Code exactly did the Housing Bureau use to lock up the report? In fact, the Code clearly states that even if information is unfinished, a department can still release it as long as it adds explanatory notes. So the Housing Bureau is simply making excuses.

levels.text: 宏福苑火災之後，居民都好想睇驗樓報告，但係房屋局一直拒絕公開。《明報》記者早喺五月初就根據《公開資料守則》向房屋局索取報告，等到六月底，房屋局先話：因為將有雨季風季、樓宇結構要持續監測，加上報告未完成可能令人誤解，所以唔公開。記者馬上要求覆檢，又向申訴專員公署投訴，指收購宏福苑涉及公帑同公眾利益。但申訴署喺八月回覆話，未見表面證據顯示房屋局違反《守則》，唔會再跟進。作者質疑：房屋局究竟引用邊條《守則》呢？原來《守則》2.13(a)話，如果披露未完成嘅分析可能令人誤解，部門「可」拒絕。但同一份指引又講明，只要「附上註釋解釋資料嘅不足」，部門依然可以公開。所以房屋局其實係斷章取義。而家房屋局推緊一項重大政策，直接影響近二千戶居民嘅去留，理應同步畀足夠資料居民，唔應該用「報告未完成」做藉口全部保密。
levels.text_en: After the fire at Wang Fuk Court, residents wanted to see the building inspection report, but the Housing Bureau kept refusing to make it public. A Ming Pao reporter, back in early May, requested the report from the Housing Bureau under the Code on Access to Information. It wasn't until late June that the Bureau said: because the rainy and typhoon season was coming, the building structure needed ongoing monitoring, and an unfinished report could mislead people, it would not release it. The reporter immediately requested a review and also complained to the Office of the Ombudsman, pointing out that the acquisition of Wang Fuk Court involved public funds and the public interest. But in August the Ombudsman replied that there was no prima facie evidence the Housing Bureau violated the Code, and it would not follow up further. The author questions: which clause of the Code exactly did the Housing Bureau cite? It turns out Code section 2.13(a) says that if disclosing an unfinished analysis could mislead people, a department 'may' refuse. But the same guidance also states that as long as it 'attaches notes explaining the shortcomings of the information,' the department can still release it. So the Housing Bureau is actually quoting out of context. Right now the Housing Bureau is pushing a major policy that directly affects the future of nearly two thousand households; it should be providing residents with sufficient information at the same time, and should not use 'the report isn't finished' as an excuse to keep everything secret.

levels.text: 宏福苑火災之後，居民想看驗樓報告，但房屋局一直不肯公開。《明報》記者五月初依據《公開資料守則》向房屋局索取報告。等到六月底，房屋局才拒絕。理由是快到雨季風季、樓宇結構要繼續監測，加上報告未完成，公開會令人誤解。記者要求重新審視，又向申訴專員公署投訴，指出收購宏福苑用了公帑，關乎公眾利益。八月，申訴署回覆，說看不到房屋局違反《守則》，不會再跟進。但作者不同意。《守則》2.13(a)只是說部門「可以」不公開，並非必須不公開。同一份指引又寫明：只要加上說明，解釋資料哪裡不足，部門仍可以發放。所以房屋局把2.13(a)當擋箭牌，其實是斷章取義。現在房屋局正推動一項重大政策，直接影響近二千戶居民。按指引精神，局方應同步提供足夠資料，不應以報告未完成為理由全部保密。
levels.text_en: After the fire at Wang Fuk Court, residents wanted to see the building inspection report, but the Housing Bureau kept refusing to make it public. In early May a Ming Pao reporter requested the report from the Housing Bureau under the Code on Access to Information. It wasn't until late June that the Bureau refused. The reasons were that the rainy and typhoon season was approaching, the building structure needed continued monitoring, and, with the report unfinished, releasing it would mislead people. The reporter requested a re-examination and also complained to the Office of the Ombudsman, pointing out that the acquisition of Wang Fuk Court used public funds and concerned the public interest. In August the Ombudsman replied that it saw no violation of the Code by the Housing Bureau and would not follow up further. But the author disagrees. Code section 2.13(a) only says a department 'may' withhold—not that it must. The same guidance also states clearly: as long as an explanation is added noting where the information falls short, the department can still release it. So the Housing Bureau using 2.13(a) as a shield is actually quoting out of context. The Housing Bureau is now promoting a major policy that directly affects nearly two thousand households. According to the spirit of the guidance, the Bureau should provide sufficient information at the same time, and should not keep everything secret on the grounds that the report is unfinished.

levels.text: 昨日《明報》有篇報道，題為「申訴署認可房局不披露宏福驗樓報告 稱未違公開資料守則 居民：延公開為引導售業權」，我閱後只想到一個四字成語，也見於今天《東方日報》的標題「房屋局拒披露驗樓報告 災民：似官官相衞」，真是人同此心，心同此理。 《明報》在5月初曾援引《公開資料守則》（下稱《守則》），向房屋局索取宏福苑災後驗樓報告。一直等到6月底——港府真有「效率」——房屋局終以「將有雨季風季、樓宇結構安全需持續監測、披露未完成分析資料或令人誤解」為由，拒絕公開報告。記者馬上向房屋局提出覆檢、向申訴專員公署申訴，並列出多項理由，包括宏福苑收購涉公帑及公眾利益等。 7月7日房屋局回覆《明報》，堅拒披露報告。申訴專員公署在8月4日亦回覆稱，不會進一步處理申訴，理由是房屋局已援引《守則》解釋拒絕理由，未見表面證據顯示房屋局違反《守則》。我不禁好奇，房屋局到底引用了哪條《守則》去支持「封鎖報告」的決定呢？ 原來《守則》第2部定義了哪類資料可拒絕公開——留意用字是「可」，不是「須」，就算某些資料符合拒絕公布的定義，部門依然有權決定把它公開——其中2.13(a)說，「如披露與不完整或未完成的分析、研究或統計有關資料，可能會令人產生誤解」，部門可決定不披露。這就是房屋局所援引的《守則》條文。 然而關於2.13(a)的真正意思，《守則》詮釋及應用指引第2.13.2條有以下澄清：「《守則》第 2.13(a)段的條文認同，如與不完整或未完成的分析、研究或統計有關的資料會造成誤解，部門可不予披露。不過，如附上註釋解釋資料的不足之處，部門或可決定發放這類資料。」 換言之，指引本身早已預見資料不完整的情況，並提供了解決方法：若不完整的資料可能造成誤解，部門依然「可決定發放這類資料」，但須「附上註釋解釋資料的不足之處」。因此，即使宏福苑樓宇結構真的需要持續監測、評估真的尚未完成，亦不妨礙房屋局公布現有的驗樓結果，只需「附上註釋」就行。 由此可見，房屋局搬出《守則》2.13(a)作擋箭牌，根本是斷章取義。其實《守則》詮釋及應用指引第2.13.1條也寫得很清楚：分析、研究資料及統計數字，理應與其他資料一視同仁地披露；政府宣布政策決定時，亦應公布相關性質的具體資料，以協助公眾理解決定的內容與依據。 房屋局現正推動的，正正是一項重大政策決定：以「接受收購建議信件」方式處理宏福苑業權，直接影響近二千戶居民的產權和去留。既然政策已經啟動，按照指引精神，局方理應同步向居民提供充足資料，作為他們做決定的分析基礎，而非以「報告未完成」為由一概保密。 至於申訴專員公署以「未見表面證據顯示房屋局違反《守則》」為由拒絕跟進，這個結論本身也很值得商榷。公署審視的，似乎只是房屋局有沒有「援引」《守則》並「交代」理由，但這只是門面功夫，根本沒有實質審查房屋局提出的理由是否成立、是否符合《守則》原意。《守則》原意是什麼，不是由申
levels.text_en: Yesterday Ming Pao ran a report headlined 'Ombudsman endorses Housing Bureau's non-disclosure of Wang Fuk inspection report, saying it did not breach the Code on Access to Information; residents: delaying disclosure is to steer the sale of ownership.' After reading it, only one four-character idiom came to mind—one also seen in today's Oriental Daily headline 'Housing Bureau refuses to disclose inspection report; disaster victims: looks like officials shielding officials.' Truly, everyone feels the same way. In early May Ming Pao invoked the Code on Access to Information (hereafter 'the Code') to request from the Housing Bureau the post-disaster building inspection report for Wang Fuk Court. It waited all the way until late June—the Hong Kong government really is 'efficient'—before the Housing Bureau finally refused to release the report, citing that the rainy and typhoon season was coming, the building's structural safety needed ongoing monitoring, and disclosing incomplete analysis could mislead people. The reporter immediately requested a review from the Housing Bureau and lodged a complaint with the Office of the Ombudsman, listing several reasons, including that the acquisition of Wang Fuk Court involved public funds and the public interest. On 7 July the Housing Bureau replied to Ming Pao, firmly refusing to disclose the report. On 4 August the Office of the Ombudsman also replied, saying it would not take the complaint further, because the Housing Bureau had already cited the Code to explain its refusal and there was no prima facie evidence it had breached the Code. I can't help but wonder: which clause of the Code exactly did the Housing Bureau invoke to support its decision to 'lock up the report'? It turns out Part 2 of the Code defines which categories of information may be refused—note the word is 'may,' not 'must'; even if certain information meets the definition for refusing disclosure, a department still has the power to decide to release it. Among these, 2.13(a) says that if disclosing information relating to incomplete or unfinished analysis, research or statistics 'could be misleading,' a department may decide not to disclose. This is the Code clause the Housing Bureau invoked. However, regarding the true meaning of 2.13(a), section 2.13.2 of the Code's Interpretation and Application Guidelines clarifies: 'The provision in Code paragraph 2.13(a) recognizes that if information relating to incomplete or unfinished analysis, research or statistics would be misleading, a department may withhold it. However, if a note is attached explaining the shortcomings of the information, the department may decide to release such information.' In other words, the guidance itself long ago anticipated the situation of incomplete information and provided a solution: if incomplete information could be misleading, the department can still 'decide to release such information,' but must 'attach a note explaining the shortcomings of the information.' Therefore, even if Wang Fuk Court's building structure really does need continued monitoring and the assessment really is not yet complete, this does not prevent the Housing Bureau from publishing the existing inspection results—it just needs to 'attach a note.' This shows that the Housing Bureau trotting out Code 2.13(a) as a shield is basically quoting out of context. In fact, section 2.13.1 of the Code's Interpretation and Application Guidelines also states clearly: analysis, research information and statistics should be disclosed on the same footing as other information; when the government announces a policy decision, it should also publish specific information of the relevant nature to help the public understand the content and basis of the decision. What the Housing Bureau is now promoting is precisely a major policy decision: handling Wang Fuk Court's ownership by way of 'accepting the acquisition offer letter,' directly affecting the property rights and futures of nearly two thousand households. Since the policy has already been launched, then by the spirit of the guidance, the Bureau should be providing residents with sufficient information at the same time, as an analytical basis for their decisions, rather than withholding everything on the grounds that 'the report is unfinished.' As for the Office of the Ombudsman refusing to follow up on the grounds that 'there is no prima facie evidence the Housing Bureau breached the Code,' this conclusion itself is highly questionable. What the Office reviewed seems to be merely whether the Housing Bureau 'invoked' the Code and 'gave' reasons—but this is only surface work, with no substantive examination of whether the Housing Bureau's stated reasons actually hold up or conform to the intent of the Code. As for what the Code's intent is, it is not for the [Ombudsman to decide]...

A Ming Pao reporter requested it under the Code on Access to Information; the Ombudsman sided with the Housing Bureau. The author argues the Bureau is misusing the Code as an excuse.

levels.text: 有6個外傭被人告話喺深水埗一個單位無牌做牙醫，仲違反逗留條件。當中兩人認咗罪，另外四人有兩人早前已經放走。周五法官話，入境處喺現場錄嘅口供唔可以用，控方又冇其他證據，所以判兩人表證不成立，當庭放人。兩人聽到判決好激動，一個仲用紙巾抹眼淚。
levels.text_en: Six foreign domestic helpers were accused of practising dentistry without a licence at a flat in Sham Shui Po, and of breaching their stay conditions. Two of them pleaded guilty; of the other four, two had already been released earlier. On Friday the judge said the confessions recorded by Immigration at the scene could not be used, and the prosecution had no other evidence, so he ruled there was no case to answer for the two and released them in court. The two were very emotional on hearing the verdict, one wiping away tears with a tissue.

levels.text: 6 名外傭被指於深水埗一單位無牌經營牙醫診所、違逗留條件等，兩人認罪，兩人日前獲裁表證不成立，餘下兩人繼續受審。裁判官彭亮廷周五（7 日）裁定，入境處人員在拘捕現場為兩人錄取的招認口供不能呈堂，基於控方沒有其他證據，遂裁定控罪表證不成立，兩被告當庭釋放。兩人聞判時神情激動，其中一人掩面拭淚。 官指，入境處人員無搜查令、無合理懷疑進入單位，「接近構成恣意拘捕」，更在解釋權利前向被捕人錄口供，「不能排除」是想盡快取得招認，且現場人員職級亦無權羈留。官亦質疑人員均能供述細節，令人質疑上庭前曾討論案情。辯方申請訟費，官押後裁決。 入境處指，尊重法庭的裁決，並將仔細研究法庭的意見，處方會完善工作流程細節，確保執行職務時的公正性，並繼續不遺餘力打擊違法行為。 Day7｜辯方質疑入境處一度非法拘留、威嚇招認 入境處：尊重裁決仔細研究 入境處回覆《法庭線》指，尊重法庭的裁決，並將仔細研究法庭的意見。處方會完善每一個工作流程細節，確保執行職務時的公正性，並繼續不遺餘力，打擊違法行為，維持社會治安。 官裁定招認供詞不能呈堂 辯方指控方餘下證據接近零 裁判官彭亮廷周五首先就特別事項，即入境處人員在記事冊中記錄兩名被告的口頭招認供詞，以及「被羈留人士通知書」能否呈堂作出裁決，指在考慮雙方陳詞後，認為控方未能就兩項證供的表面證供舉證至毫無合理疑點，裁定特別事項表證不成立，即法庭不接納兩被告的口頭招認供詞及「被羈留人士通知書」呈堂。 主控、律政司外聘大律師施善政（Sakhrani Sanjay）表示，控方就本案沒有其他證據。辯方大律師麥晶晶（Yasmine Zahir）隨即作出中段陳詞，指本案缺乏表證，被告應毋須答辯。 辯方陳詞指，控方案情的核心在於兩名被告的口頭招認，在法庭拒納口頭招認及「被羈留人士通知書」後，「控方案情所剩下的證供極有限，若不是『零』」。 辯方指出，入境處人員非法進入涉案單位，沒有搜查令、沒有合理懷疑單位內的人干犯甚麼罪行，並作出了非法羈留；控方證物包括一張草圖，標示各被告在單位內被截停的位置，惟入境事務助理梁倩童（音譯）在庭上確認，該草圖是事後繪製。 換言之，案中無證據顯示被告在何處被裁停，入境處人員亦看不到被告在做甚麼事，她們只是坐在單位內，亦無證據顯示相關牙科用具在單位內的甚麼位置、無證據顯示被告曾觸碰任何用具。 辯方總結，本案無證據顯示被告犯下相關罪行，而即使有證據亦是站不住腳，懇請法庭終結本案，裁定表證不成立。 控方沒有陳詞。官即時裁定，基於法庭不接納記事冊上的招認供詞呈堂，本案已沒有進一步證據針對第二及第四被告，因此必須裁定表證不成立，毋須答辯，並正式裁定兩人所有罪名不成立。兩人聞判神情激動，散庭時，她們與法律團隊相擁，第四被告以紙巾拭淚。 法律101｜何謂「表證成立」？裁定表證是否成立之前，法庭在考慮甚麼？ 官：入境處人員「接近恣意拘捕」 裁判官其後讀
levels.text_en: Six foreign domestic helpers were accused of operating a dental clinic without a licence at a flat in Sham Shui Po, breaching their stay conditions and so on; two pleaded guilty, two were found earlier to have no case to answer, and the remaining two continued to stand trial. On Friday (the 7th) Magistrate Pang Leung-ting ruled that the confession statements recorded by immigration officers for the two at the arrest scene could not be admitted, and since the prosecution had no other evidence, he ruled there was no case to answer on the charges and the two defendants were released in court. The two looked emotional on hearing the verdict, one covering her face and wiping tears. The judge said immigration officers entered the flat without a search warrant and without reasonable suspicion, which "came close to arbitrary arrest", and moreover recorded statements from the arrested before explaining their rights, so it "could not be ruled out" they wanted to obtain confessions as quickly as possible; the officers present were also not of a rank with power to detain. The judge also questioned that the officers could all give details, raising suspicion that the case had been discussed before going to court. The defence applied for costs; the judge reserved his ruling. Immigration said it respected the court's ruling and would study the court's views carefully, improve its work procedures, and ensure fair law enforcement. Day 7 | Defence questions Immigration's once-unlawful detention and coerced confessions; Immigration: respects ruling, will study carefully. Immigration told Witness Hong Kong (The Witness) it respected the court's ruling and would study the court's views carefully. The department will refine every detail of its work procedures to ensure fairness in carrying out its duties, and will continue to spare no effort in combating unlawful acts and maintaining public order. Judge rules confession statements inadmissible; defence says prosecution's remaining evidence close to zero. Magistrate Pang Leung-ting first ruled on the special issues, namely whether the two defendants' oral confession statements recorded in the notebooks, and the "Notice to Person Detained", could be admitted, saying that after considering both sides' submissions, he found the prosecution had failed to prove a prima facie case for the two pieces of evidence beyond reasonable doubt, so there was no case to answer on the special issues, meaning the court would not admit the two defendants' oral confession statements and the "Notice to Person Detained". The lead prosecutor, barrister Sakhrani Sanjay externally engaged by the Department of Justice, said the prosecution had no other evidence in this case. Defence barrister Yasmine Zahir then made a submission of no case to answer, saying the case lacked a prima facie case and the defendants need not answer. The defence submitted that the core of the prosecution case was the two defendants' oral confessions, and after the court refused to admit the oral confessions and the "Notice to Person Detained", "the evidence remaining in the prosecution case is extremely limited, if not 'zero'". The defence pointed out that immigration officers unlawfully entered the flat, without a search warrant and without reasonable suspicion that anyone in the flat had committed any offence, and carried out unlawful detention; the prosecution exhibits included a sketch marking where each defendant was stopped in the flat, but immigration assistant Leung Sin-tung (transliterated) confirmed in court that the sketch was drawn afterwards. In other words, there was no evidence showing where the defendants were stopped, and immigration officers did not see what the defendants were doing; they were just sitting in the flat, and there was no evidence showing where the dental instruments were in the flat, nor any evidence that the defendants had touched any instruments. The defence concluded that there was no evidence showing the defendants had committed the offences, and even if there were it would not stand, and pleaded with the court to end the case and rule no case to answer. The prosecution made no submission. The judge immediately ruled that, since the court would not admit the confession statements in the notebooks, there was no further evidence against the second and fourth defendants, so he had to rule no case to answer, they need not answer, and formally found the two not guilty on all charges. The two were emotional on hearing the verdict; when the court rose, they embraced their legal team, and the fourth defendant wiped tears with a tissue. Law 101 | What is a "prima facie case"? articles.summary: 天文台話未來幾日都會好熱，叫大家小心中暑。

levels.text: 天文台話，有個熱帶氣旋叫鯨魚，今日會經過呂宋，慢慢會弱返落嚟，對香港冇乜大威脅。今明兩日香港啲風好細。之後就會受另一個叫白海豚嘅熱帶氣旋影響，預料未來幾日都會好熱。天文台叫大家小心自己身體，唔好中暑。
levels.text_en: The Observatory says there's a tropical cyclone called Whale that will pass over Luzon today and slowly weaken; it's no big threat to Hong Kong. The wind in Hong Kong will be light today and tomorrow. After that, Hong Kong will be affected by another tropical cyclone called White Dolphin, and it's expected to be very hot for the next few days. The Observatory tells everyone to take care of their bodies and not get heatstroke.

articles.title: 新一批銀債推出 保證息率4.25厘
articles.summary: 政府出新一批銀色債券，畀1967年或之前出世嘅香港人買，保證息率唔少過4.25厘。

levels.text: 政府又出咗新一批銀色債券，畀1967年或者之前出世嘅香港人買。呢批銀債期限三年，每手一萬蚊，保證息率唔少過4.25厘，每六個月派一次息。想買嘅人可以喺本月21日到下月4日認購。政府話咁樣可以畀長者一個安全又穩定嘅選擇。
levels.text_en: The government has issued another new batch of Silver Bonds, for Hong Kong people born in 1967 or earlier to buy. This batch of Silver Bonds has a three-year term, each lot costs HK$10,000, the guaranteed interest rate is no less than 4.25%, and interest is paid once every six months. People who want to buy can subscribe from the 21st of this month to the 4th of next month. The government says this gives the elderly a safe and stable option.

levels.text: 政府推出新一批銀色債券，畀1967年或者之前出世嘅香港居民認購。銀債期限三年，每手一萬蚊，保證息率唔少過4.25厘，每六個月派息一次，息率同本地通脹掛鉤。認購期由本月21日上午9時，到下月4日下午2時。每位投資者最多可以買100手，即係100萬蚊。財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇話，今次募集到嘅錢會撥入基本工程儲備基金。銀債下月15日正式發行。
levels.text_en: The government has launched a new batch of Silver Bonds, for Hong Kong residents born in 1967 or earlier to subscribe. The Silver Bonds have a three-year term, each lot costs HK$10,000, the guaranteed interest rate is no less than 4.25%, interest is paid once every six months, and the rate is linked to local inflation. The subscription period runs from 9am on the 21st of this month to 2pm on the 4th of next month. Each investor can buy at most 100 lots, that is HK$1 million. Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui said the funds raised this time will go into the Capital Works Reserve Fund. The Silver Bonds will be formally issued on the 15th of next month.

levels.text_en: The government has launched a new batch of Silver Bonds, for Hong Kong residents born in 1967 or earlier to subscribe. The Silver Bonds have a three-year term, each lot costs HK$10,000, the guaranteed interest rate is no less than 4.25%, interest is paid once every six months, and the rate is linked to local inflation. The subscription period is from 9am on the 21st of this month to 2pm on the 4th of next month. This batch of Silver Bonds is issued under the Infrastructure Bond Programme, with a target issuance amount of HK$50 billion, and if subscription response is good, it can be increased to at most HK$55 billion. Each investor can be allotted at most 100 lots, that is HK$1 million. Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui said the funds raised will go into the Capital Works Reserve Fund. articles.title: 跑馬地有私人屋苑疑有救生員用假證件　食環署已報警
articles.summary: 跑馬地一個私人屋苑有救生員疑用假證件，食環署已經報警同埋叫個泳池即刻關閉。

levels.text: 跑馬地有個私人屋苑，懷疑有救生員用假嘅救生員證件。食環署叫嗰個泳池即刻閂咗，仲考慮要告持牌人。食環署亦都報咗警，同另一個部門一齊跟進件事。原來屋苑昨日搵拯溺總會查一批救生員資料，今日發現有個救生員嘅證件同總會嘅紀錄唔一樣，所以即刻做嘢。
levels.text_en: At a private residential estate in Happy Valley, a lifeguard is suspected of using a fake lifeguard certificate. The FEHD ordered that pool to close immediately, and is considering prosecuting the licence holder. The FEHD also reported it to the police and is following up on the matter together with another department. It turns out the estate asked the Lifesaving Society yesterday to check a batch of lifeguard records, and today found that one lifeguard's certificate didn't match the Society's records, so they acted immediately.

levels.text_en: At a private residential estate in Happy Valley, a lifeguard is suspected of using a fake lifeguard certificate. The FEHD said the estate is at 1-5 Ventris Road; yesterday it asked the Hong Kong Life Saving Society to check a batch of lifeguard records, and today received the results, finding that one lifeguard on duty had certificate details that didn't match the Society's records, so it took action immediately.

articles.title: 鳳德道近志蓮淨苑有鹹水管滲漏　水務署正在維修
articles.summary: 水務署話鳳德道近志蓮淨苑有條鹹水管漏水，佢哋依家整緊。

levels.text: 水務署話，凌晨有人報告，話鳳德道近志蓮淨苑嗰度有條水管漏水。佢哋去睇過之後，確認呢條係鹹水管，係用嚟供沖廁水畀斧山道近瓊東街一帶。而家啲工程人員整緊，會盡快整好同恢復沖廁水，又同市民講聲對唔住。

After going to look, they confirmed it was a saltwater pipe used to supply flushing water to the Hammer Hill Road area near King Tung Street. Work crews are now fixing it, will restore the flushing water supply as soon as possible, and apologize to the public.
